A1S6_STARMAP.description: A map of a nearby planet. A a relic of an ancient civilisation<> has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
A1S6_STARMAP.name: Planetary Chart
A1S6_STARMAP.subtitle: Cartographic Data

ABAND_LOCATOR.description: A single-use<> receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies<>. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage<>. Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1<>) to begin the location process.
ABAND_LOCATOR.name: Emergency Signal Scanner
ABAND_LOCATOR.subtitle: Coordinate Data

ABAND_LOCATOR_X.description: A single-use<> receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies<>. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage<>. Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1<>) to begin the location process.
ABAND_LOCATOR_X.name: Emergency Signal Scanner (Active)
ABAND_LOCATOR_X.subtitle: Coordinate Data

ACCESS1.description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.

Provides access to low level restricted areas and outpost systems.
ACCESS1.name: AtlasPass v1
ACCESS1.subtitle: Access Card

ACCESS2.description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
 
Provides access to mid-tier restricted areas and outpost systems.
ACCESS2.name: AtlasPass v2
ACCESS2.subtitle: Access Card

ACCESS3.description:
Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species.
 
Provides access to high level restricted areas and outpost systems.
ACCESS3.name: AtlasPass v3
ACCESS3.subtitle: Access Card

AF_METAL.description:
Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly.

Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station <STELLAR>Scrap Dealer<> may find this interesting...
AF_METAL.name: Tainted Metal
AF_METAL.subtitle: Salvaged Scrap

ALBUMENPEARL.description:
Gemstone formed over the course of centuries within the egg of a super-incubatory species. Highly ornamental, these gems are themselves living seeds, lucent grains of potential life.

Can be sold at a <TECHNOLOGY>Galactic Trade Terminal<>.
ALBUMENPEARL.name: Albumen Pearl
ALBUMENPEARL.subtitle: Trade commodity

ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.description: An additional storage nodule<> for Sentient<> starships. Upon hatching, the parasite inside this sac is grafted upon the vessel, exchanging the use of its cavernous innards for vital nutrients from the host. Use FE_ALT1<><> to trigger growth and begin the hatching process<>.
ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.name: Spawning Sac
ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Storage Sac

ALIEN_TECHBOX.description: A writhing sac of genetic fluid, designed to foster the creation of new bio-infused technology<> for a sentient starship<>. The embryo will grow into bio-technology upgrade<>. Begin biogenesis<> with FE_ALT1<><>.
ALIEN_TECHBOX.name: Psychonic Egg
ALIEN_TECHBOX.subtitle: Pulsating Yolk Sac

ALLOY1.description:
A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from <EARTH>Paraffinium<> and <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<>.

In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.
ALLOY1.name: Aronium
ALLOY1.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY2.description:
A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour.

Crafted from <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<> and <EARTH>Pyrite<>.
ALLOY2.name: Dirty Bronze
ALLOY2.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY3.description:
Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Ammonia<>.

Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.
ALLOY3.name: Herox
ALLOY3.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY4.description:
Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<> and <EARTH>Uranium<>.

Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.
ALLOY4.name: Lemmium
ALLOY4.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY5.description:
Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Phosphorus<>.

Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.
ALLOY5.name: Magno-Gold
ALLOY5.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY6.description:
Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from <EARTH>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Dioxite<>.

A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.
ALLOY6.name: Grantine
ALLOY6.subtitle: Alloy Metal

ALLOY7.description:
Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Herox<>, <SPECIAL>Dirty Bronze<> and <SPECIAL>Lemmium<>.
ALLOY7.name: Geodesite
ALLOY7.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal

ALLOY8.description:
Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Aronium<>, <SPECIAL>Magno-Gold<> and <SPECIAL>Grantine<>.
ALLOY8.name: Iridesite
ALLOY8.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal

AMMO.description:
Advanced munition fragments, constructed to fit Universal Multi-Tool Standard 07/FF1.

Easily inserted into the <TECHNOLOGY>Boltcaster<>, <TECHNOLOGY>Pulse Spitter<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Scatter Blaster<> via the Multi-Tool clip reloading system.
AMMO.name: Projectile Ammunition
AMMO.subtitle: Universal Ammo Module

AM_HOUSING.description:
Secure antimatter containment device, required before <FUEL>Antimatter<> can be safely secured as <FUEL>Warp Cells<>.

Rebound <FUEL>Oxygen<> forms a protective gas pocket, preventing the antimatter from reacting with the surrounding casing.
AM_HOUSING.name: Antimatter Housing
AM_HOUSING.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

ANTIMATTER.description:
Contained negative matter and baryogenesis antiparticles.
 
The vast energy potential of antimatter makes it highly valuable. 95% of existing antimatter consumption is in the powering of <TECHNOLOGY>starship hyperdrives<>.

<FUEL>WARNING<>: uncontained usage is not recommended.
ANTIMATTER.name: Antimatter
ANTIMATTER.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

ANY_BONE.description:
A highly refined food product, created in the <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<>. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets.

Food such as this can be <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.
ANY_BONE.name: Any Edible Bone
ANY_BONE.subtitle: Ingredient Category

ANY_FISH.description:
A piece of seafood, created in the <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<>. Food such as this can be <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.

Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.
ANY_FISH.name: Any Seafood
ANY_FISH.subtitle: Ingredient Category

ANY_FISH_COOKED.description:
A piece of seafood, created in the <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<>. Food such as this can be <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.

Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.
ANY_FISH_COOKED.name: Any Cooked Seafood
ANY_FISH_COOKED.subtitle: Ingredient Category

ANY_FISH_RAW.description:
A piece of seafood, created in the <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<>. Food such as this can be <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.

Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.
ANY_FISH_RAW.name: Any Raw Seafood
ANY_FISH_RAW.subtitle: Ingredient Category

ANY_MILK.description:
An animal byproduct, this nutritious morsel can be easily farmed without harm to the animal that produces it.

Process in a <TECHNOLOGY>Nutrient Processor<> to generate edible products.
ANY_MILK.name: Milk
ANY_MILK.subtitle: Raw Ingredient

ARTIFACT_KEY.description: A key of some weight, this aged piece of wrought iron must belong in a nearby lock...
ARTIFACT_KEY.name: Ancient Key
ARTIFACT_KEY.subtitle: Timeless Artifact

ASTEROID1.description:
Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.
ASTEROID1.name: Silver
ASTEROID1.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

ASTEROID2.description:
Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.
ASTEROID2.name: Gold
ASTEROID2.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

ASTEROID3.description:
Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically <COMMODITY>mined from asteroids<>. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits.

Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.
ASTEROID3.name: Platinum
ASTEROID3.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral

ATLAS_SEED_1.description: Atlas Seed containing zonally-shifted quasi-stellar substrate. Warning: do not allow matrix to commune with this dimensional space.
ATLAS_SEED_1.name: Captured Nanode
ATLAS_SEED_1.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_10.description: An Atlas Seed containing a time-locked quantum cilia suspended in a photonic shell. No others are known to exist.
ATLAS_SEED_10.name: Heart of the Sun
ATLAS_SEED_10.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_2.description: This Atlas Shell holds the remains of a parasitic space-borne lifeform, most likely of extra-dimensional origins.
ATLAS_SEED_2.name: Englobed Shade
ATLAS_SEED_2.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_3.description: An Atlas Seed capable of resonating on humanoid telepathic frequencies; may attempt to subsume any subordinate intellect in close proximity.
ATLAS_SEED_3.name: Noospheric Orb
ATLAS_SEED_3.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_4.description: An Atlas Seed shell encompassing a void element harvested from the collapse state of the last universe. Toxic if ingested.
ATLAS_SEED_4.name: Dark Matter
ATLAS_SEED_4.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_5.description: Sculpted tau neutrino-boson matrix fixed within an irreplaceable Atlas Seed shell. May be semi-sentient.
ATLAS_SEED_5.name: Dawn's End
ATLAS_SEED_5.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_6.description: This irreplaceable Atlas Seed is a form of matter-adapted photons coalesced into physical solidity by unknown means.
ATLAS_SEED_6.name: Photic Jade
ATLAS_SEED_6.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_7.description: For unknown reasons, this unique Atlas Seed has been phased out of alignment with this quantum reality. Contents cannot be determined.
ATLAS_SEED_7.name: State Phasure
ATLAS_SEED_7.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_8.description: Atlas Seed contains neutronium elements from a catastrophic supernova event that obliterated a sentient civilization in an earlier era.
ATLAS_SEED_8.name: Novae Reclaiment
ATLAS_SEED_8.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_SEED_9.description: This one-of-a-kind Atlas Seed holds an aesthetically pleasing mathematical construct salvaged from the simulation of an alternate reality.
ATLAS_SEED_9.name: Modified Quanta
ATLAS_SEED_9.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

ATLAS_STONE.description:
A spherical gem that seems to pulsate with red light from its centre.
 
An extremely rare item often associated with ancient monolithic sites.
ATLAS_STONE.name: Atlas Stone
ATLAS_STONE.subtitle: Very high value curiosity

BAIT_BASIC.description: Basic creature bait<>. Can be placed directly or accessed via the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>). This bait will attract creatures and cause them to yield Faecium<>. Once a creature has been fed, they may be tamed<> or farmed<> for their produce. Dropping bait may calm angry<> creatures.
BAIT_BASIC.name: Creature Pellets
BAIT_BASIC.subtitle: Compressed Nutrients

BAIT_MEAT_1.description: A specialist bait<> for carnivores<>. Use the Analysis Visor<> to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures. Created in a Nutrient Processor<> from Mordite<> and assorted creature flesh<>. Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden<> or harvested<>. It will also calm predators<>. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
BAIT_MEAT_1.name: Synthetic Worms
BAIT_MEAT_1.subtitle: Carnivore Bait

BAIT_MEAT_2.description: A specialist bait<> for carnivores<>. Use the Analysis Visor<> to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures. Created in a Nutrient Processor<> from Mordite<> and assorted creature flesh<>. Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden<> or harvested<>. It will also calm predators<>. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
BAIT_MEAT_2.name: Ground Meat
BAIT_MEAT_2.subtitle: Carnivore Bait

BAIT_MEAT_3.description: A specialist bait<> for carnivores<>. Use the Analysis Visor<> to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
BAIT_MEAT_3.name: Pheromone Sac
BAIT_MEAT_3.subtitle: Carnivore Bait

Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden<> or harvested<>. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).

BAIT_VEG_1.subtitle: Herbivore Bait

Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
BAIT_VEG_4.name: Sweetened Compost
BAIT_VEG_4.subtitle: Herbivore Bait

BIGGS_POI_LOC.description: A single-use<> device for locating the wreckage of starships in deep space. Select the Rangefinder and Scan for Debris<> (FE_ALT1<>) to begin the location process.
BIGGS_POI_LOC.name: Debris Rangefinder
BIGGS_POI_LOC.subtitle: Deep-Space Salvage Locator

BIO.description:
A specialist <TECHNOLOGY>biological catalysation device<>.

This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
BIO.name: Amino Chamber
BIO.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

BIOSHIP_COMP1.description:
A <STELLAR>biomechanical construct<>, created to the design of an anonymous host.

This device appears to offer an interface between an individual entity and a greater shared consciousness. It appears derived from, but not attuned to, Korvax technology.
BIOSHIP_COMP1.name: Consciousness Bridge
BIOSHIP_COMP1.subtitle: Reactivated Neural Ladder

BIOSHIP_COMP2.description:
A <STELLAR>biomechanical construct<>, created to the design of an anonymous host.

Organic, but aglow with heat and possessing a highly-pressurised inner vessel. This 'device' is part pump, and part accelerated evolutionary chamber.
BIOSHIP_COMP2.name: Pulsating Core
BIOSHIP_COMP2.subtitle: Superheated Life Fragment

BIOSHIP_COMP3.description:
A <STELLAR>biomechanical construct<>, created to the design of an anonymous host.

A fine mesh of tightly woven fibre. Micro-organisms embedded within the weave allow it to regenerate endlessly, a perfect and infinite bionic skin.
BIOSHIP_COMP3.name: Impossible Membrane
BIOSHIP_COMP3.subtitle: Auto-Regenerating Lifeform

BIOSHIP_COMP4.description:
A <STELLAR>biomechanical construct<>, created to the design of an anonymous host.

Capsules of genetic material, encased in a film of living glass. Shared memories swim in the their reflective surfaces, waiting for their chance to shape the life within.
BIOSHIP_COMP4.name: Seeds of Glass
BIOSHIP_COMP4.subtitle: Frozen Archive

BIOSHIP_COMP5.description:
A <STELLAR>biomechanical construct<>, created to the design of an anonymous host.

A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.
BIOSHIP_COMP5.name: Archived Soul
BIOSHIP_COMP5.subtitle: Bionic Ark

BIOSHIP_EGG1.description:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.

When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a world beset by <SPECIAL>powerful anomalies<> and <STELLAR>strange colours<>.
BIOSHIP_EGG1.name: Active Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG1.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity

BIOSHIP_EGG2.description:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.

When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a <STELLAR>dust-covered world<> of <FUEL>extreme storms<>.
BIOSHIP_EGG2.name: Stirring Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG2.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity

BIOSHIP_EGG3.description:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.

When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a <TECHNOLOGY>water world<> covered in <TRADEABLE>lush and verdant plantlife<>.
BIOSHIP_EGG3.name: Awakened Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG3.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity

BIOSHIP_EGG4.description:
An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated.

When touched, conjures a powerful visions of a planet of strange anomalies, one minute a world of grass, the next a world of bizarre fungal growths...
BIOSHIP_EGG4.name: Cracking Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG4.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity

BIOSHIP_EGG5.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful visions of pink and blue, colours seared into the mind of the holder. The Hunter SLASH<> The Reflection SLASH<> The Hunter SLASH<> The Spiral of Reality SLASH<> The Star Over WaterSLASH<> The Ascending Orb SLASH<> The Obscured Companion SLASH<> The Hunter SLASH<> The Lowly Insect SLASH<> The Anomaly SLASH<> The Sailor SLASH<> The Ocean King SLASH<> EUCLID EUCLID EUCLID
BIOSHIP_EGG5.name: Cracking Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG5.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity

BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.description:
This web of living tissue has grown its own metallic filaments, a mesh of silver and flesh. It crackles with its own electric charge, a network in need of its nodes.

It awaits its host.
BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.name: Mature Neural Stem
BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.subtitle: Living Starship Organ

BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.description:
Powerful and muscular, this bionic pump sits within a network of synthetic tubes. It twitches when touched, its rhythms sensitive to the presence of other thinking entities.

It awaits its host.
BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.name: Mature Heart Node
BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.subtitle: Living Starship Organ

BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.description:
Translucent, reflective, iridescent, impossibly strong. This shell swiftly reconfigures itself upon damage, knitting itself back together stronger than ever before. The newly formed bonds create a memory in glass, reflecting back the light absorbed at the moment of damage.

It awaits its host.
BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.name: Hardened Shell
BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.subtitle: Living Starship Organ

BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.description:
A sensitive arrangement of neurons in a stable orbit around a miniature black hole. The mind at the heart of this bionic miracle is free from the constraints of linear time, its experience an impossible web of myriad collected lifeforms.

It awaits its host.
BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.name: Singularity Core
BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.subtitle: Living Starship Organ

BIOSHIP_STEM1.description:
A delicate web of living tissue, this is the spark that will ignite a new lifeform into existence.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.
BIOSHIP_STEM1.name: Fragile Neural Stem
BIOSHIP_STEM1.subtitle: Fragment of Life

BIOSHIP_STEM2.description:
Though nothing more than a cluster of cells, it is already possible to detect the soft beating of this proto-heart.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.
BIOSHIP_STEM2.name: Fragile Heart
BIOSHIP_STEM2.subtitle: Fragment of Life

BIOSHIP_STEM3.description:
Translucent and impossibly thin, this shell is no more than the merest breath of glass. And yet the potential is clear, a relentless multiplicative hardening adding constantly to its strength.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.
BIOSHIP_STEM3.name: Fragile Shell
BIOSHIP_STEM3.subtitle: Fragment of Life

BIOSHIP_STEM4.description:
A slow knitting together of flesh, neurons and antimatter. The way this mind experiences the universe is beyond any imagining.

It requires careful attendance while it matures.
BIOSHIP_STEM4.name: Growing Singularity
BIOSHIP_STEM4.subtitle: Fragile Breath

BLUE2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Indium is found on planets orbiting <TECHNOLOGY>blue stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
BLUE2.name: Indium
BLUE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue

BOSS_JUICE.description: The water in this vessel seems to stretch on forever, plunging down to dizzying depths, far beyond what the container could possibly hold. Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1<>. Beware what lurks in the deep water...
BOSS_JUICE.name: Elixir of Water
BOSS_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

BP_SALVAGE.description:
The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form.

These databanks can be spent at a <TECHNOLOGY>Construction Research Unit<> and used to research new <STELLAR>Construction Blueprints<>.
BP_SALVAGE.name: Salvaged Data
BP_SALVAGE.subtitle: Salvaged Technology

BUI_SCRAP.description:
A purified drop of <SPECIAL>Atlantideum<>, refined to its very essence. This precious material is acquired by earning favour with and assisting the <TRANS_BUI>Autophage<>.

Visit the <TECHNOLOGY>Autophage Synthesis Terminal<> found at all Autophage camps to exchange Void Motes for <STELLAR>unique customisation options<>.
BUI_SCRAP.name: Void Mote
BUI_SCRAP.subtitle: Essence of Atlantid

CARBON_SEAL.description:
A high-performance <FUEL>carbon seal<>, able to withstand both the harsh interstellar environment and the rigours of intensive, high-energy industrial use.

User is advised to regularly check seal integrity after installation.
CARBON_SEAL.name: Hermetic Seal
CARBON_SEAL.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

CASING.description:
A lightweight metal product, heavily used in the manufacture of <TECHNOLOGY>starship parts<> and <TECHNOLOGY>deployable technology<>. A mainstay of the construction industries of all known primary species.

Crafted from <EARTH>Ferrite Dust<>.
CASING.name: Metal Plating
CASING.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

CATALYST1.description:
A powerful <CATALYST>catalyst<>, useful for charging <COMMODITY>defensive technologies<> such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate <CATALYST<>sodium-rich flora<>.

A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.
CATALYST1.name: Sodium
CATALYST1.subtitle: Unrefined Catalytic Element

CATALYST2.description:
An <CATALYST>advanced catalyst<>, useful for charging <COMMODITY>defensive technologies<> such as shields or hazard protection.
 
Created in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface.

Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.
CATALYST2.name: Sodium Nitrate
CATALYST2.subtitle: Refined Catalytic Element

CATAPROD3.description:
Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear <TECHNOLOGY>Hazardous Material Gauntlets<> before handling.

Synthesised from <TRADEABLE>Sodium<>.
CATAPROD3.name: Destablised Sodium
CATAPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Sodium Deposit

CATA_CRAFT.description:
An advanced circuit component.

The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.
CATA_CRAFT.name: Sodium Diode
CATA_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

CAVE1.description:
Mined from <TECHNOLOGY>underground minerals<>, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of <COMMODITY>Ion Batteries<>.

It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to make the most of its inherent charge.
CAVE1.name: Cobalt
CAVE1.subtitle: Subterranean Mineral

CAVE2.description:
A highly energised form of <TECHNOLOGY>Cobalt<>, this processed metal can be used to create <COMMODITY>Advanced Ion Batteries<>, a conveniently portable source of energy for the <TECHNOLOGY>Exosuit<>.

In widespread use as a key component in the creation of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies and structures<>.
CAVE2.name: Ionised Cobalt
CAVE2.subtitle: Processed Subterranean Mineral

CAVECUBE.description:
An ancient object, unearthed from the depths of a planetary cave system. Its surface is cold to the touch, and is curiously polished despite its age.

A fusion of metal and rock, these cubes have proved resistant to industrial processing. As such, they are of value only to collectors.

Can be sold at a <TECHNOLOGY>Galactic Trade Terminal<>.
CAVECUBE.name: Vortex Cube
CAVECUBE.subtitle: Trade commodity

CAVEPROD3.description:
A novel molecular form of <TECHNOLOGY>Cobalt<>, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare.

Synthesised from <TECHNOLOGY>Ionised Cobalt<>.
CAVEPROD3.name: TetraCobalt
CAVEPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Cobalt Deposit

CAVE_CRAFT.description:
A specialist optical component.

Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.
CAVE_CRAFT.name: Cobalt Mirror
CAVE_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

CHART_BUI_SETTL.description: A map showing the location of a nearby Autophage planetary settlement, acquired from an Autophage Synthesis Terminal<>. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
CHART_BUI_SETTL.name: Autophage Settlement Chart
CHART_BUI_SETTL.subtitle: Harmonic Planetary Chart

CHART_EMPTY.description:
A map of a nearby planet.

The chart is barren, devoid of any lifesigns or indications of settled territory.
CHART_EMPTY.name: Planetary Chart (Empty)
CHART_EMPTY.subtitle: Cartographic Data

CHART_HIVE.description: A strange, shifting map. Though hard to focus upon, this chart appears to show the location of a nearby Sentinel Pillar<>. Such Sentinel strongholds house many secrets... Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
CHART_HIVE.name: Sentinel Boundary Map
CHART_HIVE.subtitle: Anomalous Planetary Location Data

CHART_ROBOT.description: A curious mesh of old and new technology, a hybrid between two entirely separate methods of creation. Nonetheless, this location tracing device<> appears fully functional. Select this device and use Resonate (FE_ALT1<>)<> to trace its harmonic origin.
CHART_ROBOT.name: Echo Locator
CHART_ROBOT.subtitle: Harmonic Location Tracker

CHART_SETTLE.description: A map showing the location of a nearby planetary settlement, acquired from the Space Station Cartographer<>. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
CHART_SETTLE.name: Settlement Chart
CHART_SETTLE.subtitle: Specialist Planetary Chart

CHART_TREASURE.description: A map of a nearby planet. An ancient ruined site has been marked. Excavating this site is likely to yield valuable treasures<>. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
CHART_TREASURE.name: Artifact Chart
CHART_TREASURE.subtitle: Dig Site Cartographic Data

CLAMPEARL.description:
Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater.

Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.
CLAMPEARL.name: Living Pearl
CLAMPEARL.subtitle: Semi-Conscious Gemstone

COLD1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TECHNOLOGY>frozen environment<>.
COLD1.name: Dioxite
COLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

COMPOUND1.description:
A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers.

Crafted from <FUEL>Thermic Condensate<> and <FUEL>Enriched Carbon<>.
COMPOUND1.name: Organic Catalyst
COMPOUND1.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPOUND2.description:
An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator.

Crafted from <FUEL>Thermic Condensate<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Nitrogen Salt<>.
COMPOUND2.name: Semiconductor
COMPOUND2.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPOUND3.description:
A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture.

Crafted from <FUEL>Enriched Carbon<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Nitrogen Salt<>.
COMPOUND3.name: Hot Ice
COMPOUND3.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPOUND4.description:
An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials.

Crafted from <FUEL>Organic Catalyst<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Nitrogen Salt<>.
COMPOUND4.name: Fusion Accelerant
COMPOUND4.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPOUND5.description:
An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor.

Crafted from <FUEL>Enriched Carbon<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Semiconductors<>.
COMPOUND5.name: Superconductor
COMPOUND5.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPOUND6.description:
An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Hot Ice<> and <FUEL>Thermic Condensate<>
COMPOUND6.name: Cryo-Pump
COMPOUND6.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product

COMPUTER.description:
An extremely fast <TECHNOLOGY>advanced processing unit<>. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed.

Used in the creation of a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
COMPUTER.name: Quantum Computer
COMPUTER.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

CREATURE1.description:
Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound.

It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically <TRADEABLE>cultivated<> and harvested from the <SPECIAL>Mordite Root<> plant.
CREATURE1.name: Mordite
CREATURE1.subtitle: Harvested Substance

DEEPSEA_PROD.description:
A etheral shard, this translucent plane is both mineral and alive, both of the water and of another realm.

Of high value to collectors across the universe.
DEEPSEA_PROD.name: Sea Glass
DEEPSEA_PROD.subtitle: Precious Material

DRONE_BROKEN.description:
The shell of a <SPECIAL>Sentinel drone<>, all that remains after its destruction in combat. While the exterior is physically intact, its internals have been severely burned.

Given the right tools and several exotic components, it may be possible to <TECHNOLOGY>repair<> it.
DRONE_BROKEN.name: Undamaged Drone Shell
DRONE_BROKEN.subtitle: Sentinel Debris

DRONE_FRIEND.description: A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone<>. Select the device and use Activate Flare<> (FE_ALT1<>) to signal [The Drone<>]. While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory<>, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.
DRONE_FRIEND.name: Sentinel Flare (Off)
DRONE_FRIEND.subtitle: Sentinel Communicator

DRONE_FRIEND_X.description: A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone<>. Select the device and use Deactivate Broadcast (FE_ALT1<>) to stop signalling [ The Sentry ]. While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory<>, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.
DRONE_FRIEND_X.name: Sentinel Flare
DRONE_FRIEND_X.subtitle: Sentinel Communicator

DRONE_PART_E2.description:
A thin, <STELLAR>shimmering thread<>, once owned by Iteration: Gemini. This impossible fibre, once a treasured keepsake, sings on the wavelength of the Space Anomaly.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in <TECHNOLOGY>repairing<> the shattered Drone.
DRONE_PART_E2.name: Nanite Filament
DRONE_PART_E2.subtitle: Drone Component

DRONE_PART_E3.description:
A vial of the portal's <TECHNOLOGY>blue amber<>, given to you by Iteration: Mercury. The ether of the Atlas itself, this is primeval liquid from which it weaves the multiverse.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in <TECHNOLOGY>repairing<> the shattered Drone.
DRONE_PART_E3.name: Portal Phylactery
DRONE_PART_E3.subtitle: Drone Component

DRONE_PART_P.description:
A handful of <SPECIAL>glassy orbs<>, once owned by Specialist Polo. Their pearlescent surface does not reflect the world around them, offering instead a mirror to different reality.

A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in <TECHNOLOGY>repairing<> the shattered Drone.
DRONE_PART_P.name: Beads of Glass
DRONE_PART_P.subtitle: Drone Component

DRONE_SALVAGE.description:
A pane of watchful <SPECIAL>g l a s s<>, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's <TECHNOLOGY>Dissonance Resonators<>. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings.

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key <TECHNOLOGY>Sentinel ship technologies<>.
DRONE_SALVAGE.name: Inverted Mirror
DRONE_SALVAGE.subtitle: Burning Glassy Remnant

DRONE_SHARD.description:
A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something...

Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key <TECHNOLOGY>Sentinel ship technologies<>.
DRONE_SHARD.name: Radiant Shard
DRONE_SHARD.subtitle: Glassy Reality Intrusion

DUSTY1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>desert environment<>.
DUSTY1.name: Pyrite
DUSTY1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

EXOTIC_BIOPROD.description:
Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description.

Of <TECHNOLOGY>unknown origin<>.
EXOTIC_BIOPROD.name: Living Water
EXOTIC_BIOPROD.subtitle: Glassy Indeterminance

EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This unusual ceremonial staff was hand-forged by a Korvax Priest Entity in tribute to the Atlas. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.name: Atlas Sceptre
EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?

EXPD_BIOFRIG.description:
This peaceful space giant is a mutation of organism and starcraft, and can be tamed to swim through the stars alongside a fleet of frigates.

Recruiting this creature will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a <TECHNOLOGY>Fleet Command Room<> aboard your freighter, and consult your <TECHNOLOGY>Navigator<> to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.
EXPD_BIOFRIG.name: Organic Frigate
EXPD_BIOFRIG.subtitle: Cosmic Leviathan

EXPD_EGG_03.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <FUEL>nightmarish<> and <FUEL>soul-consuming<>.
EXPD_EGG_03.name: Whispering Companion Egg
EXPD_EGG_03.subtitle: Horrific Spawn

EXPD_EGG_04.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

Curled within the shell is a hungry wormlet, its coils rippling restlessly.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <FUEL>cursed<> and <FUEL>insatiable<>.
EXPD_EGG_04.name: Sandworm Egg
EXPD_EGG_04.subtitle: Titanic Spawn

EXPD_EGG_05.description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

The shell crackles with an electronic energy.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be <SPECIAL>tireless<> and <SPECIAL>watchful<>.
EXPD_EGG_05.name: Quad Egg
EXPD_EGG_05.subtitle: Sentinel Spawn Capsule

EXPD_EGG_08.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

Floating within the shell is a haunting glow, a beacon both beautiful and cursed.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <SPECIAL>gelatinous<> and <TECHNOLOGY>spectral<>.
EXPD_EGG_08.name: Helios Egg
EXPD_EGG_08.subtitle: Captured Space Protozoa

EXPD_EGG_09.description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A regular electronic beeping can be heard from within the egg, soft and somehow reassuring.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be <SPECIAL>meticulous<> and <SPECIAL>dependable<>.
EXPD_EGG_09.name: Robo-Warden Egg
EXPD_EGG_09.subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule

EXPD_EGG_11.description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, <TRADEABLE>ready to deploy!<>

A low hum resonates from deep within the capsule, its dissonant frequency turning the air around it a faint purple.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be <SPECIAL>free-spirited<> and <SPECIAL>defiant<>.
EXPD_EGG_11.name: Construct 'Egg'
EXPD_EGG_11.subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule

EXPD_EGG_13.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <FUEL>nightmarish<> and <FUEL>soul-consuming<>.
EXPD_EGG_13.name: Appalling Egg
EXPD_EGG_13.subtitle: Spawning Sac

EXPD_EGG_14.description:
A writhing cocoon, the spawning sac of a grub of the <TRADEABLE>vile brood<>.

Scans indicate the being within has <SPECIAL>anomalous<> genetic material, an <FUEL>unstable<> binding of several independent strands.
EXPD_EGG_14.name: Grub Cocoon
EXPD_EGG_14.subtitle: Vile Larval Sac

EXPD_EGG_16.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A living fire burns within the egg, the haunting pale glow of a lifeform that must provide its own light.

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <SPECIAL>gelatinous<> and <STELLAR>luminescent<>.
EXPD_EGG_16.name: Glowing Egg
EXPD_EGG_16.subtitle: Bioluminescent Spawning Sac

EXPD_EGG_18.description:
A living, fertile egg, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A foetal creature of bone grows inside, its delicate body suspended in vitellus. Its fleshless limbs are comprised of soft cartilage, which will harden and densify as it grows. 

Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be <SPECIAL>skeletal<> and <STELLAR>elephantine<>.
EXPD_EGG_18.name: Fossilised Egg
EXPD_EGG_18.subtitle: Bone Cradle

EXPD_EGG_19.description:
A metal 'egg' capsule, <TRADEABLE>ready to hatch!<>

A muffled squeaking can be heard from the synthetic creature inside the capsule.

Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be intelligent and loving, through prone to gnawing on electronics.
EXPD_EGG_19.name: Mecha-Mouse Egg
EXPD_EGG_19.subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule

EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.description:
The remains of a long-abandoned <STELLAR>frigate<>. Despite its ruined condition, it sails on through the stars...

Recruiting this vessel will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a <TECHNOLOGY>Fleet Command Room<> aboard your freighter, and consult your <TECHNOLOGY>Navigator<> to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.
EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.name: Ship of the Damned
EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.subtitle: Cursed Frigate

EXPD_ODD_EGG.description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.
EXPD_ODD_EGG.name: Void Egg
EXPD_ODD_EGG.subtitle: Living Curiosity

EXPD_SHIP01.description: An exclusive golden edition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship<>, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition<>, 'Pioneers'. This highly-manoeuvrable spacecraft is constructed from a durable and precious alloy, and coated in a tough layer of fibrous insulation to endure many lifetimes' worth of rigorous space exploration. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP01.name: Golden Vector
EXPD_SHIP01.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SHIP09.description: A unique and exclusive starship<>, commemorating completion of the Utopia<> expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project. This versatile craft is plated with radiation-resistant armour, and engineered with an aerodynamic profile for agility during atmospheric flight. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP09.name: Utopia Speeder
EXPD_SHIP09.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SHIP12.description: A unique and exclusive starship<>, commemorating completion of the Omega<> expedition. This unusual starship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP12.name: Starborn Runner
EXPD_SHIP12.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SHIP13.description: A unique and exclusive starship<>, commemorating completion of the Adrift<> expedition. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP13.name: Iron Vulture
EXPD_SHIP13.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SHIP16.description: An exclusive starship<>, retrieved while escaping the reality collapse that occurred during the Cursed Expedition<>. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP16.name: Boundary Herald
EXPD_SHIP16.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SHIP17.description: An exclusive starship<>, earned for surveying a host of new worlds during the Titan Expedition<>. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_SHIP17.name: The Wraith
EXPD_SHIP17.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

EXPD_SPEC02.description:
The <TECHNOLOGY>SSV Normandy SR1<> is a one-of-a-kind 'deep scout' frigate. This legendary ship represents peace and cooperation between races, and commemorates completion of the 'Beachhead' <STELLAR>Expedition<>.

Recruiting this frigate will add it to your fleet. Manage your frigate fleet from a <TECHNOLOGY>Fleet Command Room<> aboard your freighter, and consult your <TECHNOLOGY>Navigator<> to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.
EXPD_SPEC02.name: SSV Normandy SR1
EXPD_SPEC02.subtitle: Exclusive Frigate

EXPD_STAFF_17.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This sturdy staff is hewn from polished stone, and yet floats in the hand as if it were no weight at all. It is a perfect companion to those who seek to make long trips across the wilderness. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_STAFF_17.name: Pillar of Titan
EXPD_STAFF_17.subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?

EXPD_STAFF_18.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. The skull of an ancient beast sits atop this fused pillar of bone and circuitry. Beware its gaze... Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
EXPD_STAFF_18.name: Basilisk Crown
EXPD_STAFF_18.subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?

EXP_CURIO1.description:
The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity.
 
Highly prized by all species, not least its own.
EXP_CURIO1.name: Korvax Casing
EXP_CURIO1.subtitle: High value curiosity

EXP_CURIO2.description: Device used by the Korvax for the storage of historical and cultural information.
EXP_CURIO2.name: Convergence Cube
EXP_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity

EXP_CURIO3.description:
A glitching, pulsing data unit. It does not seem to belong in this reality.

The cube gives the impression of a silent scream, the frozen cries of hundreds of lost minds trapped within.
EXP_CURIO3.name: Divergence Cube
EXP_CURIO3.subtitle: Anomalous Data Unit

EX_BLUE.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

Indium is found on planets orbiting <TECHNOLOGY>blue stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.

This Indium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.
EX_BLUE.name: Activated Indium
EX_BLUE.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue

EX_GREEN.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

This Emeril has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

Emeril is found on planets orbiting <TRADEABLE>green stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.
EX_GREEN.name: Activated Emeril
EX_GREEN.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Green

EX_PURPLE.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic mineral<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

Quartzite is found on planets orbiting <SPECIAL>purple stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.

This quartzite has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.
EX_PURPLE.name: Activated Quartzite
EX_PURPLE.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple

EX_RED.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

This Cadmium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

Cadmium is found on planets orbiting <FUEL>red stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.
EX_RED.name: Activated Cadmium
EX_RED.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red

EX_YELLOW.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

This Copper has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

Copper is found on planets orbiting <CATALYST>yellow stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>.
EX_YELLOW.name: Activated Copper
EX_YELLOW.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow

EYEBALL.description:
The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive.

Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.
EYEBALL.name: Hypnotic Eye
EYEBALL.subtitle: Horrific Sample

FACT_TOKEN.description:
A portable data unit, compatible with most <STELLAR>planetary fabricator facilities<>.

Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.
FACT_TOKEN.name: Factory Override Unit
FACT_TOKEN.subtitle: Advanced Research Module

FARMPROD1.description:
Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Mordite<> and <TRADEABLE>Fungal Mould<>.
FARMPROD1.name: Acid
FARMPROD1.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD2.description:
A synthetic lubricant that reduces wear and prolongs the lifespan of technologies with moving parts.

Crafted from <FUEL>Faecium<> and <TRADEABLE>Gamma Root<>.
FARMPROD2.name: Lubricant
FARMPROD2.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD3.description:
Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use.

Refined from <STELLAR>Silicate<> powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a <TECHNOLOGY>Terrain Manipulator<>.

Can be crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Frost Crystals<> extracted from plants on <TECHNOLOGY>frozen<> worlds.
FARMPROD3.name: Glass
FARMPROD3.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD4.description:
A thermal regulator produced from refined organic material. It is unique in its ability to produce, dissipate and distribute heat as required.

Crafted from <SPECIAL>Solanium<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Frost Crystals<>.
FARMPROD4.name: Heat Capacitor
FARMPROD4.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD5.description:
A connective fibre for electronics, made from an advanced synthetic polymer and capable of serving as a conduit for power and data.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Cactus Flesh<> and <TRADEABLE>Star Bulbs<>.
FARMPROD5.name: Poly Fibre
FARMPROD5.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD6.description:
A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Cactus Flesh<>.
FARMPROD6.name: Unstable Gel
FARMPROD6.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD7.description:
A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment. Do not drink.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Acid<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Unstable Gel<>.
FARMPROD7.name: Liquid Explosive
FARMPROD7.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD8.description:
An advanced building material, this glass has been imbued with organic compounds that allow it to react to the environment. Microbes within the glass filter harmful light of all wavelengths and balance the atmosphere as required.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Lubricant<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Glass<>.
FARMPROD8.name: Living Glass
FARMPROD8.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FARMPROD9.description:
Stackable, semi-flexible circuit board made from a highly durable synthetic polymer.

Crafted from <COMMODITY>Heat Capacitors<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Poly Fibre<>.
FARMPROD9.name: Circuit Board
FARMPROD9.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product

FIENDCORE.description: A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.
FIENDCORE.name: Larval Core
FIENDCORE.subtitle: Monstrosity

FISHBAIT_1.description: A piece of specialist bait<>, designed to improve the size and rarity of your catch. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_1.name: Mealworms
FISHBAIT_1.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHBAIT_2.description: A piece of specialist bait<>, designed to greatly improve the size and rarity of your catch. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_2.name: Spicy Chum
FISHBAIT_2.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHBAIT_3.description: A specialist lure<>, designed to vastly improve the size and rarity of your catch. Of particular interest to anglers seeking legendary fish<>. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_3.name: Bionic Lure
FISHBAIT_3.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHBAIT_DAY.description: A specialist lure<>, designed to attract diurnal<> fish. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_DAY.name: Dangling Orb
FISHBAIT_DAY.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHBAIT_NIGHT.description: A specialist lure<>, designed to attract nocturnal<> fish. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_NIGHT.name: Shadow Lure
FISHBAIT_NIGHT.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHBAIT_STORM.description: A specialist lure<>, designed to attract fish that are only active during storms<>. Locate your Fishing Rig<> and begin bait application with FE_ALT1<>.
FISHBAIT_STORM.name: Magpulse Lure
FISHBAIT_STORM.subtitle: Fishing Bait

FISHCORE.description:
A highly-pressurised fleshy orb.

One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.
FISHCORE.name: Hadal Core
FISHCORE.subtitle: Horrific Sample

FREI_INV_TOKEN.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of an <STELLAR>abandoned freighter<> found floating in space. May also be salvaged during <STELLAR>frigate expeditions<>.

Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its <STELLAR>inventory capacity<>. Apply at your freighter's <TECHNOLOGY>Upgrade Terminal<>.
FREI_INV_TOKEN.name: Cargo Bulkhead
FREI_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Auto-Expanding Freighter Module

FRIGATE_FUEL_1.description:
A small barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.
FRIGATE_FUEL_1.name: Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_1.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel

FRIGATE_FUEL_2.description:
A large barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.
FRIGATE_FUEL_2.name: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_2.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel

FRIGATE_FUEL_3.description:
A huge barrel of frigate fuel.

This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.
FRIGATE_FUEL_3.name: Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_3.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel

FRIG_BOOST_COM.description:
A <COMMODITY>temporary frigate upgrade<> that lasts for one expedition.

This pack of autonomous explosives have been programmed to launch from the fleet and pilot themselves directly towards hostile vessels. Extremely dangerous.
FRIG_BOOST_COM.name: Explosive Drones
FRIG_BOOST_COM.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade

FRIG_BOOST_EXP.description:
A <COMMODITY>temporary frigate upgrade<> that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful analytic computer overclocks the existing fleet systems, allowing for faster-than-light calculations. Heat is a problem, and the chips do not last long.
FRIG_BOOST_EXP.name: Holographic Analyser
FRIG_BOOST_EXP.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade

FRIG_BOOST_MIN.description:
A <COMMODITY>temporary frigate upgrade<> that lasts for one expedition.

The mineral compressor allows fleet mining crews to liquidise the substances they extract, for both faster processing and easier transportation.
FRIG_BOOST_MIN.name: Mineral Compressor
FRIG_BOOST_MIN.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade

FRIG_BOOST_SPD.description:
A <COMMODITY>temporary frigate upgrade<> that lasts for one expedition.

This powerful fuel upgrade overloads frigate engines, allowing for faster-than-usual travel.
FRIG_BOOST_SPD.name: Fuel Oxidiser
FRIG_BOOST_SPD.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade

FRIG_BOOST_TRA.description:
A <COMMODITY>temporary frigate upgrade<> that lasts for one expedition.

The mind control device plugs into the ship's trading and communications systems, allowing the Fleet Commander to gain the upper hand in any negotiation.
FRIG_BOOST_TRA.name: Mind Control Device
FRIG_BOOST_TRA.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade

FRIG_TOKEN.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from <STELLAR>freighter crashsites<> or salvaged during <STELLAR>frigate expeditions<>.

Useless in its current form, a <TECHNOLOGY>Research Station<> aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.
FRIG_TOKEN.name: Salvaged Frigate Module
FRIG_TOKEN.subtitle: Capital Ship Wiring Platform

FUEL1.description:
The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to <FUEL>recharge mining equipment<>.
 
The <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.
FUEL1.name: Carbon
FUEL1.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element

FUEL2.description:
Advanced material, processed from regular <FUEL>carbon<> in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>.

The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio.

Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a <TECHNOLOGY>Advanced Mining Laser<>.
FUEL2.name: Condensed Carbon
FUEL2.subtitle: Refined Organic Element

FUELPROD3.description:
Hyper-compressed <FUEL>carbon<>, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component.

Synthesised from <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
FUELPROD3.name: Carbon Crystal
FUELPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Carbon Deposit

F_ALL_LEG_L1.description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."
F_ALL_LEG_L1.name: Dragonfish
F_ALL_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_M1.description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."
F_ALL_LEG_M1.name: Golden Jellyfish
F_ALL_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_S1.description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."
F_ALL_LEG_S1.name: Singing Sea-Snail
F_ALL_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ALL_LEG_XL.description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."
F_ALL_LEG_XL.name: The Lunker
F_ALL_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_BOSS_JELLY.description:
A glassy jellyfish, lights pulsing beneath its skin. Its thin tentacles pluck at the air, their vibrations manipulating the space around its body.

As it writhes, a faint music drifts from its tendrils, worming its way into your ears. The melody seems to never end, worming its way into your ears, never ending, worming its way into your ears, never ending, never...
F_BOSS_JELLY.name: Spawn of Arcadia
F_BOSS_JELLY.subtitle: Fragile Medusoid

F_BOTTLE.description: A sealed bottle, found floating in the water. There appears to be a message inside. Use FE_ALT1<><> to unseal<> the bottle and read the message within.
F_BOTTLE.name: Message in a Bottle
F_BOTTLE.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

F_COLD_LEG_L1.description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."
F_COLD_LEG_L1.name: Iceblood Gulper
F_COLD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_M1.description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."
F_COLD_LEG_M1.name: Ghostfin
F_COLD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_S1.description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."
F_COLD_LEG_S1.name: Crystal Jelly
F_COLD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_COLD_LEG_XL.description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."
F_COLD_LEG_XL.name: Nautilia
F_COLD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_L1.description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.name: The Hunter Below
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_M1.description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.name: Brain Eel
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_S1.description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.name: Sentient Crab
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DEEP_LEG_XL.description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.name: Leviathan Spawn
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_L1.description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."
F_DUST_LEG_L1.name: Ossified Deinosuchus
F_DUST_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_M1.description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."
F_DUST_LEG_M1.name: Titanworm Larva
F_DUST_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_S1.description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."
F_DUST_LEG_S1.name: Fragile Icthyoscale
F_DUST_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_DUST_LEG_XL.description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."
F_DUST_LEG_XL.name: Megalodon
F_DUST_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_L1.description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."
F_GAS_LEG_L1.name: Hyper-cockle
F_GAS_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_M1.description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."
F_GAS_LEG_M1.name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
F_GAS_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_S1.description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."
F_GAS_LEG_S1.name: Mandelbrot Worm
F_GAS_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_GAS_LEG_XL.description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."
F_GAS_LEG_XL.name: The Maw of Titan
F_GAS_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_L1.description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."
F_HOT_LEG_L1.name: Jelly of the Veil
F_HOT_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_M1.description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."
F_HOT_LEG_M1.name: Mirrorscale Skipper
F_HOT_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_S1.description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."
F_HOT_LEG_S1.name: Starshell Crab
F_HOT_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_HOT_LEG_XL.description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."
F_HOT_LEG_XL.name: Ancient Irontail
F_HOT_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_JELLYCHILD.description:
An impossibly delicate jellyfish. Its tentacles are as fine as strands of hair, its entire being glassy, dancing on the edge of what is possible.

A gift from the sea, almost too precious to keep...
F_JELLYCHILD.name: Child of Aquarius
F_JELLYCHILD.subtitle: Precious Spawn

F_LUSH_LEG_L1.description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.name: Reef Guardian
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_M1.description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.name: Mist Serpent
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_S1.description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.name: Glass Angel
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_LUSH_LEG_XL.description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.name: Blind Titancore
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_L1.description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."
F_ODD_LEG_L1.name: Child of Helios
F_ODD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_M1.description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."
F_ODD_LEG_M1.name: Atlantidian Crab
F_ODD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_S1.description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."
F_ODD_LEG_S1.name: Abyssal Horror Egg
F_ODD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_ODD_LEG_XL.description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."
F_ODD_LEG_XL.name: Many-Mouthed Lunker
F_ODD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_L1.description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."
F_RAD_LEG_L1.name: Gamma Squid
F_RAD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_M1.description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."
F_RAD_LEG_M1.name: Aberrant Duskfin
F_RAD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_S1.description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."
F_RAD_LEG_S1.name: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
F_RAD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_RAD_LEG_XL.description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."
F_RAD_LEG_XL.name: Helix Sawfish
F_RAD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_L1.description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."
F_TOX_LEG_L1.name: Bleached Bonefish
F_TOX_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_M1.description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."
F_TOX_LEG_M1.name: Vampire Squid
F_TOX_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_S1.description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."
F_TOX_LEG_S1.name: Emeril Sunstar
F_TOX_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TOX_LEG_XL.description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."
F_TOX_LEG_XL.name: Translucent Gulper
F_TOX_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish

F_TRASH_1.description:
A piece of flotsam, wrenched from its years of drifting in the water when it became entangled in a fishing lure.

Of little use to anyone.
F_TRASH_1.name: Kelp Strand
F_TRASH_1.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

F_TRASH_2.description:
A piece of flotsam, wrenched from its years of drifting in the water when it became entangled in a fishing lure.

Of little use to anyone.
F_TRASH_2.name: Tangleweed
F_TRASH_2.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

Of little use to anyone.
F_TRASH_3.name: Sea Sponge

Of little use to anyone.
F_TRASH_4.name: Bleached Coral
F_TRASH_4.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

F_TRASH_5.name: Expired Braincoral
F_TRASH_5.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

F_TRASH_6.name: Ossified Coral
