Of little use to anyone.
F_TRASH_7.name: Old Boot
F_TRASH_7.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

F_TRASH_8.description: A technology upgrade that has been permanently damaged<> by prolonged exposure to water. Use FE_ALT1<><> to begin upgrade installation process<>.
F_TRASH_8.name: Rusted Technology
F_TRASH_8.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

GAS1.description:
A pungent atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<>. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life.

With the aid of <TECHNOLOGY>specialised machinery<>, can be extracted from the atmospheres of <FUEL>Scorched<> and <SPECIAL>Desert<> planets.
GAS1.name: Sulphurine
GAS1.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS2.description:
A colourless, odourless <TRADEABLE>gas<> with a relatively short half-life. 

Found in both <COMMODITY>Radioactive<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Frozen<> atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.
GAS2.name: Radon
GAS2.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS3.description:
A reactive atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<> found wherever there is organic life.

Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of <TRADEABLE>Lush<> and <TRADEABLE>Toxic<> planets.
GAS3.name: Nitrogen
GAS3.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GAS4.description:
An atmospheric <TRADEABLE>gas<> found in the hostile conditions of <SPECIAL>gas giants<>.

Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on <TECHNOLOGY>gas<> worlds.
GAS4.name: Methane
GAS4.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas

GASGIANT1.description:
A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of <SPECIAL>gas giants<>.
GASGIANT1.name: Crystallised Helium
GASGIANT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

GAS_BRAIN_LOC.description: A single-use<> device for locating a deep-space Gaseous Sentience<>. The lure generates an electromagnetic field of an intriguing nature to these highly advanced lifeforms. Select the Lure and use Generate Field (FE_ALT1<>) to begin the location process.
GAS_BRAIN_LOC.name: Deep-Space Lure
GAS_BRAIN_LOC.subtitle: Anomaly Attraction Device

GEODE_ASTEROID.description: A highly valuable ore chunk, ready to be processed into Gold<>. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_ASTEROID.name: Gold Nugget
GEODE_ASTEROID.subtitle: Valuable Ore

GEODE_CAVE.description: An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_CAVE.name: Geode
GEODE_CAVE.subtitle: Valuable Mineral Deposit

GEODE_CRYSTAL.description: A crystalline shard with an unusually dense structure. Potentially highly valuable. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_CRYSTAL.name: Crystal Fragment
GEODE_CRYSTAL.subtitle: Concentrated Element Shard

GEODE_LAND.description: An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_LAND.name: Geode
GEODE_LAND.subtitle: Valuable Mineral Deposit

GEODE_RARE.description: Though its surface is dirtied and dull, polishing this rock reveals a deep inner glow, a glitter beneath a subtly iridescent surface. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_RARE.name: Glowing Mineral
GEODE_RARE.subtitle: Valuable Rock Sample

GEODE_SPACE.description: A shard of pure crystalised Tritium<>. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and crack open with FE_ALT1<>.
GEODE_SPACE.name: Tritium Hypercluster
GEODE_SPACE.subtitle: Energetic Fragment

GRAVBALL.description:
A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A <STELLAR>micro-rift<> is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. <FUEL>Sentinel forces<> will respond to stablise any such anomaly.

Can be sold at a <TECHNOLOGY>Galactic Trade Terminal<>.
GRAVBALL.name: Gravitino Ball
GRAVBALL.subtitle: Trade commodity

GREEN2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star.

Emeril is found on planets orbiting <TRADEABLE>green stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
GREEN2.name: Emeril
GREEN2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Green

GRENFUEL1.description:
Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the <TECHNOLOGY>Plasma Launcher<>.
 
Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.
GRENFUEL1.name: Unstable Plasma
GRENFUEL1.subtitle: Plasma Launcher Recharge

HEXCORE.description: This strange energy orb constantly vibrates, emitting a low-frequency drone. Slight variations in the pattern repeat over and over, almost as if it is attempting to relay a message.
HEXCORE.name: Hex Core
HEXCORE.subtitle: Contained Reality Glitch

HOT1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>scorched environment<>.
HOT1.name: Phosphorus
HOT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

HYDRALIC.description:
Specialist <TECHNOLOGY>wiring and control threads<>, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components.

Used in the creation of a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
HYDRALIC.name: Hydraulic Wiring
HYDRALIC.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

HYPERFUEL1.description:
This <FUEL>antimatter-based fuel<> is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a <TECHNOLOGY>starship hyperdrive<>.

Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.
HYPERFUEL1.name: Warp Cell
HYPERFUEL1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit

HYPERFUEL2.description:
A <COMMODITY>high-capacity<> <FUEL>antimatter-based fuel<>, this cell harnesses an internal black hole generator to power <TECHNOLOGY>starship hyperdrives<> across multiple warp jumps.

Cell walls are specially designed to reflect any reality paradoxes back towards the heart of the unit, where they generate additional power.
HYPERFUEL2.name: Warp Hypercore
HYPERFUEL2.subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit

ILLEGAL_PROD1.description:
Jars of murky, foul-smelling crystals. Produced in viscous evaporation traps, these organic salts are used in the manufacture of illegal pheromones.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD1.name: Blood Salt
ILLEGAL_PROD1.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD2.description:
Sealed vials of unregistered DNA samples, free of the standard biosecurity mechanisms that prevent unlawful genetic tampering.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD2.name: Stolen DNA Samples
ILLEGAL_PROD2.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD3.description:
A vat of highly volatile liquid. Its fumes are extremely flammable and a function as a powerful sedative.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD3.name: Moon Ether
ILLEGAL_PROD3.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD4.description:
A vacuum-sealed bundle of dazzlingly beautiful feathers. The animal that gave its life for this impossible, kaleidoscopic, charm is long since extinct.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD4.name: Prismatic Feathers
ILLEGAL_PROD4.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD5.description:
A canister of the now-banned Vy'keen battle gas, traditionally inhaled on the eve of battle.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD5.name: GrahGrah
ILLEGAL_PROD5.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD6.description:
Reversed-engineered from a captured space station core, these unlicensed circuits are used in a wide range of black- and grey-market technologies.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD6.name: Counterfeit Circuits
ILLEGAL_PROD6.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD7.description:
Hacked together from the salvaged remains of Sentinel forces, these potent weapons are a favourite of outlaws across the galaxy.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD7.name: Banned Weapons
ILLEGAL_PROD7.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

ILLEGAL_PROD8.description:
Relics of the fallen Gek empire, condemned and banned by all the galaxy's major civilisations.

Purchase is <SPECIAL>illegal<> at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within <FUEL>outlaw systems<>.

Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be <TRADEABLE>highly profitable<>.
ILLEGAL_PROD8.name: First Spawn Relics
ILLEGAL_PROD8.subtitle: Smuggled Goods

INVBOX.description: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion<> to aid you on your travels. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>.
INVBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Inventory)
INVBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

JELLY.description:
A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs.

Synthesised from <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<>.
JELLY.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
JELLY.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power

LAND1.description:
An abundant mineral element, found in <EARTH>rock formations<> and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<>.

Typically requires processing in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> before use in construction or technology manufacture.
LAND1.name: Ferrite Dust
LAND1.subtitle: Metallic Mineral Extract

LAND2.description:
Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of <EARTH>structures<> and <TECHNOLOGY>technologies<>.

Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an <TECHNOLOGY>Advanced Mining Laser<>.
LAND2.name: Pure Ferrite
LAND2.subtitle: Processed Metallic Minerals

LAND3.description:
Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<>.

Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.
LAND3.name: Magnetised Ferrite
LAND3.subtitle: Charged Metallic Element

LANDPROD3.description:
A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies.

Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution.

Synthesised from <EARTH>Magnetised Ferrite<>.
LANDPROD3.name: Rare Metal Element
LANDPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Metal Deposit

LAUNCHFUEL.description:
Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel <TECHNOLOGY>Starship Launch Thrusters<>.

Created from crystallised <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<>, found in blue deposits on all worlds.
LAUNCHFUEL.name: Starship Launch Fuel
LAUNCHFUEL.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel

LAUNCHSUB.description:
A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures.

Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large <TECHNOLOGY>blue crystals<>. It is a key component of <COMMODITY>Starship Launch Fuel<>.
LAUNCHSUB.name: Di-hydrogen
LAUNCHSUB.subtitle: High Energy Substance

LAUNCHSUB2.description:
A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology.

Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of <TECHNOLOGY>Di-hydrogen<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Tritium<> in <TECHNOLOGY>Refiners<>.
LAUNCHSUB2.name: Deuterium
LAUNCHSUB2.subtitle: High Energy Substance

LAVA1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <FUEL>volcanic environment<>.
LAVA1.name: Basalt
LAVA1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

LOG_KEY.description:
A fragment of the encryption override sequence for a <TECHNOLOGY>freighter's emergency log<>.

Several parts of the sequence may be required to gain full access to recorded data.
LOG_KEY.name: Log Encryption Key
LOG_KEY.subtitle: Incomplete Data Sequence

LUSH1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TRADEABLE>tropical environment<>.
LUSH1.name: Paraffinium
LUSH1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

MAGNET.description:
An electromagnetic <TECHNOLOGY>frequency oscillator<>, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties.

Used in the creation of a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
MAGNET.name: Magnetic Resonator
MAGNET.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

MECH_PROD.description:
This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a <SPECIAL>Sentinel Hardframe<> unit.

Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...
MECH_PROD.name: Hardframe Engine
MECH_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material

MEGAPROD1.description:
A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor. Generates sub-stellar levels of energy in a hassle-free, widely compatible fuel module.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Liquid Explosives<> and <FUEL>Fusion Accelerant<>.
MEGAPROD1.name: Portable Reactor
MEGAPROD1.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product

MEGAPROD2.description:
A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Circuit Boards<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Superconductors<>.
MEGAPROD2.name: Quantum Processor
MEGAPROD2.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product

MEGAPROD3.description:
A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Living Glass<> and a <TECHNOLOGY>Cryo-Pump<>.
MEGAPROD3.name: Cryogenic Chamber
MEGAPROD3.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product

MESSAGE_JUICE.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_10<><>. Present the elixir at a portal<>, or consume it with FE_ALT1<> to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.
MESSAGE_JUICE.name: Elixir of BloodPR_10<>
MESSAGE_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

MESSAGE_JUICE1.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_4<><>. Present the elixir at a portal<>, or consume it with FE_ALT1<> to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.
MESSAGE_JUICE1.name: Elixir of BloodPR_4<>
MESSAGE_JUICE1.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

MESSAGE_JUICE2.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_9<><>. Present the elixir at a portal<>, or consume it with FE_ALT1<> to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.
MESSAGE_JUICE2.name: Elixir of BloodPR_9<>
MESSAGE_JUICE2.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

MESSAGE_JUICE3.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_11<><>. Present the elixir at a portal<>, or consume it with FE_ALT1<> to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.
MESSAGE_JUICE3.name: Elixir of BloodPR_11<>
MESSAGE_JUICE3.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

MESSAGE_JUICE4.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_0<><>. Present the elixir at a portal<>, or consume it with FE_ALT1<> to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.
MESSAGE_JUICE4.name: Elixir of BloodPR_0<>
MESSAGE_JUICE4.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

MICROCHIP.description:
A compact, <TECHNOLOGY>low-heat microchip<>. Assembled from processed <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<>, created from one of several specialised terrain metals.

Used in the creation of a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
MICROCHIP.name: Microprocessor
MICROCHIP.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

MIND_ARC.description: A strange piece of technology, a gift from beyond the stars. It shimmers in a way that suggests it is not fully in this world.
MIND_ARC.name: Mind Ark
MIND_ARC.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product

MIRROR.description:
A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

Used in the creation of a wide range of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
MIRROR.name: Solar Mirror
MIRROR.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

MP_REP_PART1.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART1.name: Encrypted Navigation Computer
MP_REP_PART1.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART1B.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART1B.name: Encrypted Navigation Computer
MP_REP_PART1B.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART1C.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors.

The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.
MP_REP_PART1C.name: Navigation Computer
MP_REP_PART1C.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART2.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to ship-to-ship communications, quantum transportation, and coordinate tracing.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART2.name: Encrypted Communicator Control Unit
MP_REP_PART2.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART2B.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to ship-to-ship communications, quantum transportation, and coordinate tracing.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART2B.name: Encrypted Communicator Control Unit
MP_REP_PART2B.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART2C.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to ship-to-ship communications, quantum transportation, and coordinate tracing.

The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.
MP_REP_PART2C.name: Communicator Control Unit
MP_REP_PART2C.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART3.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship-to-Exosuit synchronisation and security.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART3.name: Encrypted User Authenticator
MP_REP_PART3.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART3B.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship-to-Exosuit synchronisation and security.

This part could be in working order, but will require <SPECIAL>decryption<> before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired <STELLAR>decryption terminal<> can be located via Exosuit analysis.
MP_REP_PART3B.name: Encrypted User Authenticator
MP_REP_PART3B.subtitle: Starship Component

MP_REP_PART3C.description:
An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship-to-Exosuit synchronisation and security.

The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.
MP_REP_PART3C.name: User Authenticator
MP_REP_PART3C.subtitle: Starship Component

MYSTERY_BEACON.description:
The result of Nada's research into unusual patterns detected in the stories of the <TRANS_TRA>Gek<>, <TRANS_EXP>Korvax<>, and <TRANS_WAR>Vy'keen<>.

The beacon broadcasts a <STELLAR>signal echo<> attuned to the shift <SPECIAL>historiographical flux<> mapped by Nada's Traveller companions.

Specialist Polo is unwilling to predict the results of the broadcast.
MYSTERY_BEACON.name: Myth Beacon
MYSTERY_BEACON.subtitle: Experimental Summoning Technology

MYSTERY_TRACKER.description:
Nada has detected a new pattern emerging in the stories of the <TRANS_TRA>Gek<>, <TRANS_EXP>Korvax<>, and <TRANS_WAR>Vy'keen<>.

The dosimeter measures exposure to <SPECIAL>historiographical flux<> around key artifact sites. Recordings of unusual historical shifts will enable Nada to trace the signal.

Assist Nada and Polo in their research by using this device to <STELLAR>transmit historial data<> from alien artifact sites.
MYSTERY_TRACKER.name: Historiographical Dosimeter
MYSTERY_TRACKER.subtitle: Personal Reality Flux Monitor

NANOTUBES.description:
Metres and metres of high capacity <FUEL>carbon nanotubes<>.

Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
NANOTUBES.name: Carbon Nanotubes
NANOTUBES.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

NAV_DATA.description:
Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region.

May be traded with a <TRADEABLE>Cartographer<> aboard a Space Station in exchange for <STELLAR>usable star charts<>.
NAV_DATA.name: Navigation Data
NAV_DATA.subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data

NAV_DATA_DROP.description: Encoded navigation data which, when properly decrypted, will reveal the location of a Drop Pod<> containing an Exosuit Inventory Upgrade<>. Select the coordinates in the inventory and use Plot Route<> (FE_ALT1<>) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.
NAV_DATA_DROP.name: Exosuit Upgrade Chart
NAV_DATA_DROP.subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data

NIPNIPBUDS.description: A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.
NIPNIPBUDS.name: NipNip Buds
NIPNIPBUDS.subtitle: Medicinal Substance

ODD_EGG.description:
An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched.

A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.
ODD_EGG.name: Void Egg
ODD_EGG.subtitle: Living Curiosity

OXYGEN.description:
Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit <FUEL>life support system<>.

Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora.

Other plantlife may be scanned with the <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<> to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.
OXYGEN.name: Oxygen
OXYGEN.subtitle: Concentrated Liquid Fuel

OXYPROD3.description:
A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended.

Synthesised from <FUEL>Oxygen<>.
OXYPROD3.name: Superoxide Crystal
OXYPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Oxygen Deposit

OXY_CRAFT.description:
A specialist technology component.

This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.
OXY_CRAFT.name: Oxygen Filter
OXY_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

PIRATE_BEACON.description: An unmarked navigation beacon<>, acquired from the wreck of a downed starship. Use Activate Beacon (FE_ALT1<>) to deploy the beacon and retrace the final steps of the crashed ship.
PIRATE_BEACON.name: Rendezvous Beacon
PIRATE_BEACON.subtitle: Navigational Data Recorder

PIRATE_INVITE.description: "Glorious survivor! The promised star<> will be yours!" A Secure system pass<> bearing the mark of the 'Voice of Freedom'<>. Select the pass and use Accept Invitation (FE_ALT1<>) to pin the location in your navigation systems.
PIRATE_INVITE.name: Ticket to Freedom
PIRATE_INVITE.subtitle: Secure System Pass

PIRATE_MAPPROD0.description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a troubled <STELLAR>freighter captain<>. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"We Blight this new galaxy, as we did the last, as we will the next!"

The data is of value to pirate faction <SPECIAL>The Blight<>, who attempted to retrieve it by violent means.
PIRATE_MAPPROD0.name: Pirate Map Fragment 1 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD0.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data

PIRATE_MAPPROD1.description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a <STELLAR>freighter<> shot down by pirate faction <SPECIAL>The Blight<>. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"The galactic tunnels belong to the Blight!"

The navigational information is corrupted, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the <STELLAR>freighter captain<>.
PIRATE_MAPPROD1.name: Pirate Map Fragment 2 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD1.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data

PIRATE_MAPPROD2.description:
Partial coordinate data, acquired from a <STELLAR>starship<> crashed on an ocean bed. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto:

"Annihilate every Traveller! All galaxies will fall to Blight!"

The navigational information is unreadable in its current state, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the <STELLAR>freighter captain<>.
PIRATE_MAPPROD2.name: Pirate Map Fragment 3 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD2.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data

PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.description: Reassembled <COMMODITY>treasure coordinate data<>, retrieved from the victims of pirate faction <SPECIAL>The Blight<>.
PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.name: Pirate Map
PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.subtitle: Illicit Geographic Data

PIRATE_PROD.description:
A unique ID <TECHNOLOGY>transponder<>, ripped from the internal signal array of an <STELLAR>outlaw starship<>.

Possesion of such a device implies the destruction of the vessel in question. Turn it over to an envoy of the <TECHNOLOGY>Mercenaries Guild<> to collect any associated bounties.
PIRATE_PROD.name: Pirate Transponder
PIRATE_PROD.subtitle: Salvaged Identification Device

PLANT_CAVE.description:
A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the <TRADEABLE>Cave Marrow plant<> found growing <TECHNOLOGY>underground<>.

The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.
PLANT_CAVE.name: Marrow Bulb
PLANT_CAVE.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_DUST.description:
Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the <TRADEABLE>Echinocactus plant<>. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses.

The Echinocactus thrives only on <FUEL>desert planets<>, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>..
PLANT_DUST.name: Cactus Flesh
PLANT_DUST.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_HOT.description:
A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the <TRADEABLE>Solar Vine<>.

The vine requires a <FUEL>hot climate<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_HOT.name: Solanium
PLANT_HOT.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_LUSH.description:
A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the <TRADEABLE>Star Bramble<>.

The host plant requires <TRADEABLE>lush conditions<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_LUSH.name: Star Bulb
PLANT_LUSH.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_POOP.description:
A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the <TRADEABLE>Gutrot Flower<>, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species.

Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.
PLANT_POOP.name: Faecium
PLANT_POOP.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_RADIO.description:
A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the <TRADEABLE>Gamma Weed plant<>.

Gamma Weed requires <COMMODITY>high background radiation<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_RADIO.name: Gamma Root
PLANT_RADIO.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_SNOW.description:
A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of <TRADEABLE>Frostwort<>.

Frostwort requires <TECHNOLOGY>frozen conditions<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_SNOW.name: Frost Crystal
PLANT_SNOW.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_TOXIC.description:
An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of <TRADEABLE>Fungal Clusters<>.

The host plant requires a <TRADEABLE>toxic climate<> to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Hydroponics Tray<>.
PLANT_TOXIC.name: Fungal Mould
PLANT_TOXIC.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

PLANT_WATER.description:
A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from <TECHNOLOGY>underwater<> <TRADEABLE>Candle Kelp<> plants.

Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.
PLANT_WATER.name: Kelp Sac
PLANT_WATER.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance

POI_LOCATOR.description: A single-use<> geometric beacon that probes the surrounding area for near-space anomalies<>. Such objects are highly unpredictable. Select the Detector and use Begin Scan (FE_ALT1<>) to begin the location process.
POI_LOCATOR.name: Anomaly Detector
POI_LOCATOR.subtitle: Anomalous Homing Device

POLICE_TOKEN.description: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.
POLICE_TOKEN.name: Defence Chit
POLICE_TOKEN.subtitle: System Authority Payment Substitute

PORTAL_JUICE.description: The liquid's silvered surface forms a perfect mirror, your own face reflected back as you examine it. But the more you stare, the less perfect the mirror becomes. The face in the image moves. It blinks. It - Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1<> to reveal the location of nearby portals<>.
PORTAL_JUICE.name: Elixir of Quicksilver
PORTAL_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

POWERCELL.description:
Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of <COMMODITY>defensive<> and <COMMODITY>hazard protection<> systems.
 
Constructed by fusing <EARTH>Ferrite Dust<> with underground <TECHNOLOGY>Cobalt<>. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.
POWERCELL.name: Ion Battery
POWERCELL.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

POWERCELL2.description:
Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of <COMMODITY>defensive<> and <COMMODITY>hazard protection<> systems.

Constructed from <TECHNOLOGY>Ionised Cobalt<> and <EARTH>Pure Ferrite<>, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.
POWERCELL2.name: Advanced Ion Battery
POWERCELL2.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

PRODFUEL1.description:
Stablised and secure <FUEL>life support<> filtration gas.

Easily assembled from <FUEL>Oxygen<> and <EARTH>Ferrite Dust<>. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.
PRODFUEL1.name: Oxygen Capsule
PRODFUEL1.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power

PRODFUEL2.description:
Emergency <FUEL>life support fuel<>.

Synthesised from <TECHNOLOGY>rocket fuel crystals<> and <FUEL>carbon<>, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.
PRODFUEL2.name: Life Support Gel
PRODFUEL2.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power

PURPLE2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic mineral<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Quartzite is found on planets orbiting <SPECIAL>purple stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
PURPLE2.name: Quartzite
PURPLE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple

PURPM_GAS_KEY.description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper <SPECIAL>anchor<> is required...
PURPM_GAS_KEY.name: Reality Anchor
PURPM_GAS_KEY.subtitle: Spacetime Tether

PURPM_LUSH_KEY.description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper <SPECIAL>anchor<> is required...
PURPM_LUSH_KEY.name: Reality Anchor
PURPM_LUSH_KEY.subtitle: Spacetime Tether

PURPM_MIRROR.description:
To bridge between realities requires a scaffold and a seed.

This crystalline propagation matrix will allow the breach to become the bridge, the seed by which a new reality can bloom.
PURPM_MIRROR.name: Anomalous Scaffold
PURPM_MIRROR.subtitle: Crystalline Breach

PURPM_PACKET.description:
The howling of an advanced intelligence banished to oblivion, a reverberation in sentience and crystal. 

Each memory in this <TECHNOLOGY>data packet<> is an entire reality in itself, bearing the fingerprint of countless lives. The <FUEL>Atlas<> will recognise this seed.
PURPM_PACKET.name: Memories of Atlantid
PURPM_PACKET.subtitle: Forgotten Void Data

PURPM_WATER_KEY.description:
A ancient newborn star exists only at the strange intersection points of time and space, where the dissonance is strongest.

To bind such a place to the rest of reality, a proper <SPECIAL>anchor<> is required...
PURPM_WATER_KEY.name: Reality Anchor
PURPM_WATER_KEY.subtitle: Spacetime Tether

QUAD_PROD.description: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.
QUAD_PROD.name: Quad Servo
QUAD_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material

QUEEN_PROD.description:
The brain stem of a <TRADEABLE>brood mother<>, pulled from its malignant corpse.

This is a valuable trophy, signifying victory in the quest to purge the infestations of the vile brood. Turn it over to an envoy of the <TECHNOLOGY>Mercenaries Guild<> to mark your triumph.
QUEEN_PROD.name: Vile Cortex
QUEEN_PROD.subtitle: Glorious Trophy

RADIO1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <CATALYST>radioactive environment<>.
RADIO1.name: Uranium
RADIO1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

REACTION1.description:
A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Sulphurine<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION1.name: Thermic Condensate
REACTION1.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION2.description:
A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Radon<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION2.name: Enriched Carbon
REACTION2.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

REACTION3.description:
A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form.

Crafted from <TRADEABLE>Nitrogen<> and <FUEL>Condensed Carbon<>.
REACTION3.name: Nitrogen Salt
REACTION3.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product

RED2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Cadmium is found on planets orbiting <FUEL>red stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
RED2.name: Cadmium
RED2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red

REPAIRKIT.description:
A highly useful piece of <STELLAR>survival technology<>, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order.

While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.
REPAIRKIT.name: Repair Kit
REPAIRKIT.subtitle: Automatic Patching Unit

REP_TOKEN.description:
A counterfeit <TECHNOLOGY>starship registration document<>. This digital signature is guaranteed free of previous crimes or misdemeanors.

Can be used to reset any negative <STELLAR>faction standing<> records at a <TECHNOLOGY>Space Station Core<>.
REP_TOKEN.name: Forged Passport
REP_TOKEN.subtitle: Overwritten Digital Record

ROBOT1.description:
This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of <SPECIAL>Sentinels<>.

Prized by the <FUEL>Vy'keen<>, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with <TECHNOLOGY>Nanites<>. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.
ROBOT1.name: Pugneum
ROBOT1.subtitle: Anomalous Material

ROBOT2.description:
This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of <SPECIAL>corrupted Sentinels<> as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom.

It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.
ROBOT2.name: Atlantideum
ROBOT2.subtitle: Disharmonic Metal

ROCKETSUB.description: Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines<>. Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids<> using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN<>) to search for tritium-rich asteroids<>.
ROCKETSUB.name: Tritium
ROCKETSUB.subtitle: Neutron-Rich Fuel Element

ROGUE_BEACON.description: A powerful but mellow musical instrument<>, capable of relaying song through space via gently undulating electromagnetic waves. Use Relay Song (FE_ALT1<>) while in deep space<> to broadcast the flute's melody...
ROGUE_BEACON.name: Whalesong Flute
ROGUE_BEACON.subtitle: Cosmic Melody Instrument

ROGUE_CARBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an Exocraft upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_CARBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Exocraft)
ROGUE_CARBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_CLASSBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as a ship or Multi-Tool class upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_CLASSBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Class)
ROGUE_CLASSBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.name: Memory Fragment
ROGUE_CRAFTBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_FINDER.description: A highly familar, entirely novel, piece of technology, designed by Specialist Polo as part of their loop research<> efforts. It synchronises its vibrations with the underlying song of the universe, allowing it to reveal memory hotspots<> within the loop. Begin the resonance alignment<> process with FE_ALT1<>.
ROGUE_FINDER.name: Memory Resonator
ROGUE_FINDER.subtitle: Loop Manifestation Technology

ROGUE_GUNBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as a Multi-Tool weapon<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_GUNBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Personal Weapon)
ROGUE_GUNBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_G_STONE1.description:
A memory is <STELLAR>burned<> into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The leviathan was like nothing I've ever seen.
So vast as to blot out the sun.
I wanted it. I deserve to have it! It will be mine.
But it resisted, would not come quietly.
It wailed and it wailed as the infra-knife carved into its meat.
It almost took me down with it. Perhaps it has. Perhaps..."
ROGUE_G_STONE1.name: Memory Imprint I
ROGUE_G_STONE1.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_G_STONE2.description:
A memory is <STELLAR>burned<> into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The same nightmare chases me: a wail fills my cockpit, the dashboard controls gummed with blood.
I have given up sleep. I pulse past blurred stars.
And then there it was: majestic, drifting in the ocean of space.
Something inside me burns for it. I must have it.
Its great fin flexed toward my ship, and my hull was gone..."
ROGUE_G_STONE2.name: Memory Imprint II
ROGUE_G_STONE2.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_G_STONE3.description:
A memory is <STELLAR>burned<> into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"Today should have been the day. Their hour was at hand.
It must be mine. They are like nothing I've ever seen.
Everything was prepared. But it moved faster than I thought possible. As though it knew where I would fly, before I knew it myself.
A great tentacle hugged my ship, my cockpit - pressing my suit down to the bone. This suit will be my grave."
ROGUE_G_STONE3.name: Memory Imprint III
ROGUE_G_STONE3.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_G_STONE4.description:
A memory is <STELLAR>burned<> into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"The chase is over, and I have lost.
The giants will endure, and I will end.
As I plummeted from the sky, I saw another ship falling alongside mine. Then another, and another.
I may have imagined it. The misfiring of a dying mind...
Those creatures were so beautiful. But it is all ended now.
They will haunt my thoughts no longer."
ROGUE_G_STONE4.name: Memory Imprint IV
ROGUE_G_STONE4.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_G_STONE5.description:
A memory is <STELLAR>burned<> into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime...

"I came face-to-face with a creature more beautiful and bizarre than anything I have ever seen.
Despite no discernible eyes, I do not believe it is blind.
It was huge, glorious, serene. But then - with a flick of its tentacles, it was gone.
I have thought of nothing else since. I can only think of the whale. whale. whale. <SPECIAL>wail<>."
ROGUE_G_STONE5.name: Memory Imprint V
ROGUE_G_STONE5.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_HAZBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an Exosuit technology upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_HAZBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Exosuit)
ROGUE_HAZBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_INVBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_INVBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Inventory)
ROGUE_INVBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_KEY.description: A relentless, despairing cry that will not let you rest. Listen at a personally significant location<> to remember what has been forgotten. DEATH IS NOT THE END SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES
ROGUE_KEY.name: A Dreadful Wailing
ROGUE_KEY.subtitle: Loop Artifact

ROGUE_SGUNBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as a starship weapon<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_SGUNBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Starship Weapon)
ROGUE_SGUNBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_SMARTBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an Multi-Tool or Ship weapon upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_SMARTBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Armament)
ROGUE_SMARTBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_STARTBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an Exosuit technology upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_STARTBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Exosuit)
ROGUE_STARTBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

ROGUE_TECHBOX.description: The shattered remnants of a previous existence<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade<> to aid you in this iteration. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>. DEATH IS NOT THE END<> SLASH<> THE LOOP CONTINUES<>
ROGUE_TECHBOX.name: Memory Fragment
ROGUE_TECHBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo

RUINSUB.description:
The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand.

Acquired by applying the <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> to the structral remnants located on <STELLAR>ruined worlds<>.
RUINSUB.name: Polished Stone
RUINSUB.subtitle: Recycled Minerals

S10_ATLAS_SEED1.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. This mere atom contains boundless noise, each tiny vibration the hopes and dreams of entire lifetimes. Use FE_ALT1<><> to resonate<> the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.name: Seed of Dreams
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED2.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A particle of indescribable energy, it is unclear how to continues to exist within this reality. Use FE_ALT1<><> to resonate<> the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.name: Seed of Power
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED3.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A flash of pure light and fury, this seed contains the unsuppressable need to exist. Use FE_ALT1<><> to resonate<> the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.name: Seed of Will
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED4.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. Though a mere speck, this seed contains the potential for an entire universe; a boundless, glorious expansion. Use FE_ALT1<><> to resonate<> the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.name: Seed of Life
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_ATLAS_SEED5.description: A seed of creation, a perfect droplet of infinity. A gift from the Atlas, this is a tiny fragment of all the universe's dreams, will, power and life; a fragment of the Travellers; a fragment of myself. Use FE_ALT1<><> to resonate<> the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.name: Seed of Hope
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas

S10_FRAGMENT.description:
A shifting vortex of <SPECIAL>atlantideum<>, attuned to the growing collective will housed inside Nada's <STELLAR>Prime Terminal<>. Current sentience threshold: <STELLAR>??%<>.

The grains oscillate in a pattern, but the message is unintelligible.
S10_FRAGMENT.name: Echo Collective
S10_FRAGMENT.subtitle: Consciousness Housing

S10_ROBO_ARMS.description:
A set of complex hydraulic tubes and various gripping surfaces that form a pair of usable arms for a <TECHNOLOGY>primitive automaton<>.

Plans for this unit were extracted from an <STELLAR>autophage<> left at an abandoned junker's camp.
S10_ROBO_ARMS.name: Construct Limbs
S10_ROBO_ARMS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_BODY.description:
The principal metallic carapace for a <TECHNOLOGY>primitive automaton<>.

Plans for this unit were extracted from an <STELLAR>autophage<> left at an abandoned junker's camp.
S10_ROBO_BODY.name: Construct Shell
S10_ROBO_BODY.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_CORE.description:
The central reactor unit and primary fuel source for a <TECHNOLOGY>primitive automaton<>.

Plans for this unit were extracted from an <STELLAR>autophage<> left at an abandoned junker's camp.
S10_ROBO_CORE.name: Atlantid Reactor
S10_ROBO_CORE.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_HEAD.description:
The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a <TECHNOLOGY>primitive automaton<>. 

Plans for this unit were extracted from an <STELLAR>autophage<> left at an abandoned junker's camp.
S10_ROBO_HEAD.name: Construct Head
S10_ROBO_HEAD.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_ROBO_LEGS.description:
A bipedal movement platform for a <TECHNOLOGY>primitive automaton<>.

Plans for this unit were extracted from an <STELLAR>autophage<> left at an abandoned junker's camp.
S10_ROBO_LEGS.name: Construct Legs
S10_ROBO_LEGS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component

S10_SOUL.description:
The <TECHNOLOGY>Seed<> is an echo of life, the last reverberations of a living being.

This sentience was fused with a lattice of <SPECIAL>Atlantideum<>, as though it had germinated together with the crystal.
S10_SOUL.name: Echo Seed
S10_SOUL.subtitle: Crystalline Sentience Cage

S12_POI_SEED1.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures. Reach the stars and then use FE_ALT1<> to awaken this memory.
S12_POI_SEED1.name: Memory of Ocean
S12_POI_SEED1.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S12_POI_SEED2.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures. Reach the stars and then use FE_ALT1<> to awaken this memory.
S12_POI_SEED2.name: Memory of Conquest
S12_POI_SEED2.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas

S12_POI_SEED3.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures. Reach the stars and then use FE_ALT1<> to awaken this memory.

S15_FISH.description:
Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away.

The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...
S15_FISH.name: The Angler
S15_FISH.subtitle: Legendary Fish

S15_MESSAGE0.description:
A message recovered from a bottle stowed beneath the seat of the starship. It reads:

<VAL_ON>"I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price.
And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the <VAL_ON>Celeste<>, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..."
%PARTY_1%<>
S15_MESSAGE0.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE0.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

S15_MESSAGE1.description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"The rumours were true. It's out there, I can feel it. Not here, but somewhere. The water calls to me, I just need to follow its voice..."
%PARTY_3%<>
S15_MESSAGE1.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE1.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

S15_MESSAGE2.description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"I saw it in my dreams last night. Scales like fire and eyes of pure starlight. It sang to me, a song of hope and longing. It wants me to find it, I know it. I must be closing in."
%PARTY_4%<>
S15_MESSAGE2.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE2.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

S15_MESSAGE3.description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"I was right! It was here! After all these light years, all the doubts, it's finally mine. Oh, and how it shines! Like fire in the water, beautiful, impossible..."
%PARTY_5%<>
S15_MESSAGE3.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE3.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

S15_MESSAGE4.description:
A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads:

<VAL_ON>"The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores.
It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free.
I must be free..."<>
S15_MESSAGE4.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE4.subtitle: Collected Flotsam

S19_TP.description: This device bypasses the mainstream teleport network, providing a direct link<> to the local Space Station. Select the device and use Activate Teleport<> (FE_ALT1<>) to instantly transfer to the nearest Space Station.
S19_TP.name: Orbital Uplink
S19_TP.subtitle: Teleport Network Tunnel

This report records the history of a planetary facility forming part of the <EXPED>Utopia Project<>. Several sections are curiously absent.

DS 2368 :: <STELLAR>Facility <><TRADEABLE>founded<><STELLAR>. Plasma deep drill rig operational.<>
DS 2384 :: <STELLAR>Return growth steady at 1%.<>
DS 2400 :: <STELLAR>Overseers querying growth rate.<>
DS 2416 :: <STELLAR>Orbital exp. approved. Station trade booming.<>
DS 2432 :: <SPECIAL>[Redacted]<> <STELLAR>hazard encountered.<>
DS 2448 :: <SPECIAL>[Redacted]<>
DS 2464 :: <STELLAR>Utopia Project launched.<>
DS 2464 :: <STELLAR>Facility <><TRADEABLE>restored<><STELLAR>. Plasma deep drill rig operational. Trade routes re-opened.<>
DS 2480 :: <SPECIAL>[Redacted]<>
DS 2496 :: <STELLAR>Facility <><TRADEABLE>restored<><STELLAR>. Plasma deep drill rig operational. Trade routes re-opened.<>
DS 2512 :: <SPECIAL>[Redacted]<>

The last two entries are repeated over and over, across hundreds of pages.

S9_MYSTERY_ITEM.subtitle: Classified Dossier

Can be sold at a <TECHNOLOGY>Galactic Trade Terminal<>.

An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a <TECHNOLOGY>Terrain Manipulator<>. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction.

Process in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create <TECHNOLOGY>Glass<>.
SAND1.name: Silicate Powder
SAND1.subtitle: Abundant Mineral

SCRAP_GOODS.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of technology. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and use FE_ALT1<> to examine the contents. No refunds.
SCRAP_GOODS.name: Suspicious Packet (Goods)
SCRAP_GOODS.subtitle: Contraband

SCRAP_TECH.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of high-value or interesting item. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and use FE_ALT1<> to examine the contents. No refunds.
SCRAP_TECH.name: Suspicious Packet (Tech)
SCRAP_TECH.subtitle: Contraband

SCRAP_WEAP.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of weapon-based technology. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and use FE_ALT1<> to examine the contents. No refunds.

SCRAP_WEAP.subtitle: Contraband

SENTFREI_PROD.description: A single splinter of the colossal mainframe at the heart of a Sentinel capital ship. It blinks, its solitary living eye trained upon the one piece of data it retains - the last known location of one of its fleet of Interceptors<>. Select the AI Fragment and use Search Archive<> (FE_ALT1<>) to translate information about Interceptor's crash site to your starship's navigation systems.
SENTFREI_PROD.name: Carrier AI Fragment
SENTFREI_PROD.subtitle: Battleship Core Remnant

SENTINEL_LOOT.description: A sinister shard of purple glass<>, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY<>) and shatter with FE_ALT1<>.
SENTINEL_LOOT.name: Salvaged Glass
SENTINEL_LOOT.subtitle: Recovered Sentinel Components

SHIPBRAIN.description:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies.

A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own <TECHNOLOGY>Pilot Interface<> for a Sentinel Interceptor.

Status: <FUEL>VOLATILE<>
SHIPBRAIN.name: Hyaline Brain
SHIPBRAIN.subtitle: Sentience Vessel

SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.description:
The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry appears stable, pulsing with a regular electrical heartbeat. It no longer reacts angrily to my presence.

Status: <TRADEABLE>DOCILE<>

Install this unit in a disabled Sentinel ship to unlock its vestigial cockpit and enable <STELLAR>manual piloting<>.
SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.name: Harmonic Brain
SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.subtitle: Harnessed Sentience

SHIPCHARGE.description:
A power storage unit optimised for use in <COMMODITY>starship defensive systems<>.
 
<SPECIAL>Tritium<>-fuelled capacitors provide quick-release charge for the <TECHNOLOGY>Deflector Shield<>, but would overload smaller-scale equipment.
SHIPCHARGE.name: Starshield Battery
SHIPCHARGE.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage

SHIP_INV_TOKEN.description:
A technology module harvested from the remains of a <STELLAR>salvaged starship<>. May also be collected from <STELLAR>freighter crash sites<> or salvaged during <STELLAR>frigate expeditions<>.

Can be used to expand starship storage capacity at the Space Station's <TECHNOLOGY>Starship Outfitter<>.
SHIP_INV_TOKEN.name: Storage Augmentation
SHIP_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Starship Expansion Module

SIGNALCHARGE.description:
A high-powered <COMMODITY>battery pack<>, designed to release a significant charge in a short space of time.

Used to power the high energy needs of <TECHNOLOGY>Signal Boosters<> as they survey planets for distant buildings.
SIGNALCHARGE.name: Surge Battery
SIGNALCHARGE.subtitle: High Voltage Energy Pack

SOULFRAG.description:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.

Generated by the interaction of the <TECHNOLOGY>Animus Beam<> with a living target.
SOULFRAG.name: Fragmented Qualia
SOULFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment

SOUL_ENGINE.description:
A powerful organic computing unit.

A glitching beat drives this miracle circuit, performing cycle after cycle in an endless, furious loop of calculation.
SOUL_ENGINE.name: Soul Engine
SOUL_ENGINE.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product

SPACEGUNK1.description:
A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Skin contact is not advised.
SPACEGUNK1.name: Residual Goop
SPACEGUNK1.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK2.description:
An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery.

Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.
SPACEGUNK2.name: Runaway Mould
SPACEGUNK2.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK3.description:
Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment.

Handle with care.
SPACEGUNK3.name: Rusted Metal
SPACEGUNK3.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK4.description:
A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own.

Nutrient source: <FUEL>unknown<>.
SPACEGUNK4.name: Living Slime
SPACEGUNK4.subtitle: Junk

SPACEGUNK5.description:
An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom.

Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.
SPACEGUNK5.name: Viscous Fluids
SPACEGUNK5.subtitle: Junk

SPECIAL_POOP.description: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.
SPECIAL_POOP.name: Hexite
SPECIAL_POOP.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element

SPEC_BB_TRACK01.description: A data storage lattice containing a single ByteBeat music track<>. Track data will be added to the 'Other Tracks' section of the ByteBeat Library<>. Access the Library from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
SPEC_BB_TRACK01.name: ByteBeat Chip: 'Nemesis101'
SPEC_BB_TRACK01.subtitle: Audio Containment Crystal

SPIDER_PROD.description:
The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection.

A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.
SPIDER_PROD.name: Crystallised Heart
SPIDER_PROD.subtitle: Corrupted Aeronic Core

SPOOK_JUICE.description: A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord. The elixir will maintain your local boundary integrity<> and prevent the intrusion of the horrors beyond<>. Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1<> or inject it directly into the Anomaly Suppressor<> from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
SPOOK_JUICE.name: Elixir of Glass
SPOOK_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction

SQUIDFRAG.description:
A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience.

Released upon the destruction of a <SPECIAL>boundary horror<>.
SQUIDFRAG.name: Shattered Qualia
SQUIDFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment

STAFF_CORE6.subtitle: Autophage Staff Core

STAFF_PART_A.description:
A strap of flexible resin, securely wrapped around a steel pole.

One of three core components, this forms the <STELLAR>backbone<> of a traditional Autophage <TECHNOLOGY>Voltaic Staff<>.
STAFF_PART_A.name: Fibreglass Grip
STAFF_PART_A.subtitle: Voltaic Component

STAFF_PART_B.description:
A compact box of circuitry and ethereal crystals, painstakingly wired by hand.

One of three core components, this forms the <STELLAR>core<> of a traditional Autophage <TECHNOLOGY>Voltaic Staff<>.
STAFF_PART_B.name: Atlantideum Chamber
STAFF_PART_B.subtitle: Voltaic Component

STAFF_PART_C.description:
An electrified arrangement of mechanical wheels. Transforms stored energy into beams or propulsion, according to the specifications of weapons and laser attachments.

One of three core components, this forms the <STELLAR>head<> of a traditional Autophage <TECHNOLOGY>Voltaic Staff<>.
STAFF_PART_C.name: Concentric Transducer
STAFF_PART_C.subtitle: Voltaic Component
