STARCHART_A.description: A map of a nearby planet. A secure site of interest<> has been marked. Such sites often hold blueprints for new products<>. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
STARCHART_A.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_A.subtitle: Secret Cartographic Data

STARCHART_B.description: A map of a nearby planet. The coordinates of a distress signal<> have been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
STARCHART_B.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_B.subtitle: Emergency Cartographic Data

STARCHART_C.description: A map of a nearby planet. An inhabited outpost<> of some kind has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
STARCHART_C.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_C.subtitle: Commercial Cartographic Data

STARCHART_D.description: A map of a nearby planet. A a relic of an ancient civilisation<> has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
STARCHART_D.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_D.subtitle: Alien Cartographic Data

STATION_KEY.description:
A portable data drive containing the <STELLAR>AI override codes<> for a Space Station Core.

The importance of the station AI core ensures that such keys are both highly regulated and extremely profitable on the black market.
STATION_KEY.name: Station Override
STATION_KEY.subtitle: AI Master Key

STELLAR2.description:
A processed metal alloy, created in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> from the <STELLAR>stellar metals<>: <COMMODITY>Copper<>, <FUEL>Cadmium<>, <TRADEABLE>Emeril<> and <TECHNOLOGY>Indium<>.

The <SPECIAL>rarer<> the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce.

This valuable metal is used in the creation of many <TECHNOLOGY>advanced technologies<>.
STELLAR2.name: Chromatic Metal
STELLAR2.subtitle: Highly Refined Stellar Metal

STONE_EYE_PROD.description:
An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds.

<FUEL>Warning<>: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of <SPECIAL>living stone guardians<>. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.
STONE_EYE_PROD.name: Vigilant Stone
STONE_EYE_PROD.subtitle: Unblinking Eye

STORM_CRYSTAL.description: A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on <FUEL>extreme weather planets<>.
STORM_CRYSTAL.name: Storm Crystal
STORM_CRYSTAL.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity

SUBFUEL.description:
A high thermal energy fuel, contained within a standardised fuel cell. Used to fuel the <TECHNOLOGY>Humboldt Drive<> that powers the Nautilon submarine.

Created with a mix of organic compounds (<FUEL>Carbon<> and <TRADEABLE>cyto-phosphates<>) and localised mineral <TRADEABLE>salts<>.
SUBFUEL.name: Hydrothermal Fuel Cell
SUBFUEL.subtitle: Submarine Reactor Fuel

SUIT_INV_TOKEN.description:
An advanced survival technology module that allows expansion of a user's <STELLAR>Exosuit Storage<>.

Pre-packed nano-expanders create stablised sub-warp voids within the Exosuit, increasing its <STELLAR>inventory capacity<>. Apply this augmentation at the Exosuit upgrade terminal on board a <STELLAR>Space Station<>.
SUIT_INV_TOKEN.name: Exosuit Expansion Unit
SUIT_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Upgrade Unit

SUNGOLD.description:
Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form.

Extracted from metallic <STELLAR>terrain deposits<> using a <TECHNOLOGY>Solar Ray<>. Enormously energetic.
SUNGOLD.name: Liquid Sun
SUNGOLD.subtitle: Transmuted Metal

SWITCH_GUN01.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This brightly-coloured rifle offers the user cutting-edge defensive capabilities in ground combat situations. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
SWITCH_GUN01.name: Infinite Neon Mark XXII
SWITCH_GUN01.subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device

SWITCH_SHIP01.description: An exclusive Starship<>. This compact fighter craft boasts superior manoeuvrability, giving it an edge in space combat. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
SWITCH_SHIP01.name: Horizon Vector NX
SWITCH_SHIP01.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

TECHBOX.description: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller<>. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade<> to aid you on your travels. Absorb<> this memory with FE_ALT1<><>.
TECHBOX.name: Memory Fragment
TECHBOX.subtitle: Technology Echo

TECHFRAG.description:
A dense miasma of <TECHNOLOGY>Nanites<>, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.

Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.
TECHFRAG.name: Nanite Cluster
TECHFRAG.subtitle: Technological Currency

TECHFRAG_R.description:
A dense miasma of <TECHNOLOGY>Nanites<>, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter.

Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.
TECHFRAG_R.name: Nanites
TECHFRAG_R.subtitle: Technological Currency

TECH_COMP.description:
A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of <TECHNOLOGY>technology components<>.

The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.
TECH_COMP.name: Wiring Loom
TECH_COMP.subtitle: Universal Technology Platform

TGA_SHIP01.description: An exclusive reforged starship<>, commemorating a time when Travellers old and new joined together to voyage across the stars. This unusual ship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes. Claim<> this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
TGA_SHIP01.name: Starborn Phoenix
TGA_SHIP01.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft

TIMEDUST.description:
Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories.

Collected from the fine layers it forms around hotspots in the loop. Of great value to <SPECIAL>Specialist Polo<> as they <STELLAR>research the loop<>.
TIMEDUST.name: Somnal Dust
TIMEDUST.subtitle: Decayed Spacetime Remnant

TIMEMILK.description:
The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy.

Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to <SPECIAL>Specialist Polo<> as they <STELLAR>research the loop<>.
TIMEMILK.name: Ancestral Memories
TIMEMILK.subtitle: Recessive Creature Genes

TOXIC1.description:
Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on planets with a <TRADEABLE>toxic environment<>.
TOXIC1.name: Ammonia
TOXIC1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

TRA_ALLOY1.description:
A packed crate of carbon nanotubes.

These tiny but incredibly strong tubes are required in the construction of tiny but incredibly strong <SPECIAL>scientific components<>.
TRA_ALLOY1.name: Nanotube Crate
TRA_ALLOY1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)

TRA_ALLOY2.description:
A hopper of self-repairing Heridium. It looks fresh.

Used in the creation of <SPECIAL>scientific components<>. Self-repairing heridium is particularly useful for deployment in remote facilities, where maintenance opportunities may be limited or deadly.
TRA_ALLOY2.name: Self-Repairing Heridium
TRA_ALLOY2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)

TRA_ALLOY3.description:
Several bottles of optical solvent.

The liquid in these bottles is used to wash away surplus light that may otherwise cause decay in <SPECIAL>scientific components<>.
TRA_ALLOY3.name: Optical Solvent
TRA_ALLOY3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)

TRA_ALLOY4.description:
A specially manufactured container of five-dimensional tori.

Highly specific materials are required to construct shapes in extra dimensions. These tori are used to contain the strong fields generated in the manufacture of <SPECIAL>scientific components<>.
TRA_ALLOY4.name: 5D Torus
TRA_ALLOY4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)

TRA_ALLOY5.description:
A densely layered package of superconducting fibres.

Powerful, flexible, and water-resistant; the controlled magnetic weave of these fibres is vital in the creation of many <SPECIAL>scientific components<>.
TRA_ALLOY5.name: Superconducting Fibre
TRA_ALLOY5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)

TRA_COMMODITY1.description:
A crate packed with hard drives, each of which contain vast amounts of decrypted user data.

Individually of low value, taken together these repositories can be processed and scanned for valuable data. This processing occurs in systems with <SPECIAL>advanced material<> economies.
TRA_COMMODITY1.name: Decrypted User Data
TRA_COMMODITY1.subtitle: Trade Goods

TRA_COMMODITY2.description:
Several spools of star silk.

Star silk is woven on enormous solar looms in orbit around trading planets. Cosmic ray impact triggers the pattern of the weave, which can then be used in <SPECIAL>advanced material<> processing.
TRA_COMMODITY2.name: Star Silk
TRA_COMMODITY2.subtitle: Trade Goods

TRA_COMMODITY3.description:
Several canisters of comet droplets.

An elaborate trading name for chunks of meteorite, these rocks are nonetheless extremely valuable to the <SPECIAL>advanced material<> economies that can process them.
TRA_COMMODITY3.name: Comet Droplets
TRA_COMMODITY3.subtitle: Trade Goods

TRA_COMMODITY4.description:
A packed crate of ion spheres.

These delicate glass spheres house a small-scale replica of the upper atmosphere. Sparkly and hypnotic to look at, these baubles are also of importance in the manufacture of <SPECIAL>advanced material<> alloys.
TRA_COMMODITY4.name: Ion Sphere
TRA_COMMODITY4.subtitle: Trade Goods

TRA_COMMODITY5.description:
A bundle of precisely calibrated teleport coordinators.

These pin-prick sized circuits are vital to the delicate process of inserting reinforcing material into <SPECIAL>advanced alloys<>. They can also aid long-distance sales efforts.
TRA_COMMODITY5.name: Teleport Coordinators
TRA_COMMODITY5.subtitle: Trade Goods

TRA_COMPONENT1.description:
Several huge cogs.

Sturdy, well-made metal gears. While not advanced technology themselves, they're a vital component in countless pieces of <SPECIAL>high-tech<> machinery all over the galaxy.
TRA_COMPONENT1.name: Enormous Metal Cog
TRA_COMPONENT1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)

TRA_COMPONENT2.description:
Wrapped and greased pistons, ready for shipping.

<SPECIAL>High-tech<> components frequently require rapidly moving parts, or high-endurance motors. Without specially coated pistons, the failure rate of such parts would be significantly higher.
TRA_COMPONENT2.name: Non-Stick Piston
TRA_COMPONENT2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)

TRA_COMPONENT3.description:
A crate of mesh decouplers.

The creation of <SPECIAL>high-tech<> components often involves accidental mesh-coupling. These decouplers are particularly powerful, being able to deploy six prongs simultaneously.
TRA_COMPONENT3.name: Mesh Decouplers
TRA_COMPONENT3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)

TRA_COMPONENT4.description:
Packed and separated data containers for holographic crankshafts.

Real crankshafts are frequently too large, noisy or hard-to-maintain for use in delicate machines. When faced with such a situation, <SPECIAL>high-tech<> manufacturers turn to these holographic substitutes.
TRA_COMPONENT4.name: Holographic Crankshaft
TRA_COMPONENT4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)

TRA_COMPONENT5.description:
A large crate of high-capacity vector compressors.

The creation of interstellar drives often requires dimensions to be condensed and then re-rendered. Such <SPECIAL>high-tech<> component manufacture would not be possible without industrial-grade compressors such as these.
TRA_COMPONENT5.name: Vector Compressors
TRA_COMPONENT5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)

TRA_CURIO1.description:
A metal statuette of a creature with a coin placed in its beak.
 
Popular with many traders who see it as an emblem of fair commerce and peace.
TRA_CURIO1.name: Gek Relic
TRA_CURIO1.subtitle: Medium value curiosity

TRA_CURIO2.description:
Edible product much beloved by the Gek.
 
Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time.
 
GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.
TRA_CURIO2.name: GekNip
TRA_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity

TRA_ENERGY1.description:
A crate packed with spark canisters.

Many industrial and <SPECIAL>mining<> processes have considerable power demands. A counterpart to the slow release of a battery, spark canisters are able to meet these demands instantaneously.
TRA_ENERGY1.name: Spark Canister
TRA_ENERGY1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)

TRA_ENERGY2.description:
A packet of well-isolated industrial batteries.

Heavy-duty batteries are required to power deep level <SPECIAL>mining<>operations. These highly durable sources can last for weeks, even in the extremes of heat and pressure found kilometres underground.
TRA_ENERGY2.name: Industrial-Grade Battery
TRA_ENERGY2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)

TRA_ENERGY3.description:
Several packets of ohmic gel.

Power-hungry <SPECIAL>mining<> operations are fraught with danger. Ohmic gel helps keep rapidly moving parts both insulated and lubricated.
TRA_ENERGY3.name: Ohmic Gel
TRA_ENERGY3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)

TRA_ENERGY4.description:
Corrosion-resistant barrels of an experimental power fluid.

One barrel of this highly volatile concoction is enough to power a space station for weeks on end. Particularly valued by <SPECIAL>mining<> economies.
TRA_ENERGY4.name: Experimental Power Fluid
TRA_ENERGY4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)

TRA_ENERGY5.description:
A slightly glowing bundle of fusion cores.

Power source, engine, high-capacity heater. A fusion core is the ultimate in deep-space power generation. Highly valued by <SPECIAL>mining<> economies looking to make their asteroid colonies more self-sufficient.
TRA_ENERGY5.name: Fusion Core
TRA_ENERGY5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)

TRA_EXOTICS1.description:
A loose collection of recycled pheromone bottles.

Vast quantities of pheromones are produced and distributed every day. This has spawned a lucrative <SPECIAL>trading<> opportunity for those willing to deal with the waste products. These glass jars have been thoroughly scrubbed and should pose no threat to the carrier.
TRA_EXOTICS1.name: De-Scented Bottles
TRA_EXOTICS1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)

TRA_EXOTICS2.description:
A parcel of neutron microscopes.

Scientific economies produce and consume large numbers of microscopes. However, some have slight defects that render them unsuitable for precision work. These are still a <SPECIAL>trading<> opportunity, in that they can be sold to those unable to tell the difference.
TRA_EXOTICS2.name: Neutron Microscope
TRA_EXOTICS2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)

TRA_EXOTICS3.description:
A jumbled box of instability injectors.

Grand experiments often require a large number of variables to be changed in a very short period of time. An instability injector provides such a service. They can also be used to create chaos in market systems; such unethical behaviour represents an excellent <SPECIAL>trading<> opportunity.
TRA_EXOTICS3.name: Instability Injector
TRA_EXOTICS3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)

TRA_EXOTICS4.description:
A vat of preserved organic piping. Still warm.

To avoid difficult ethical problems, many labs grow their test subjects on a component level. The leftovers can be profitable in <SPECIAL>trading<> economies with relaxed medical regulations.
TRA_EXOTICS4.name: Organic Piping
TRA_EXOTICS4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)

TRA_EXOTICS5.description:
A box of fresh neural ducts.

Neural ducts are temporary inserts designed for a brief boost of concentration and productivity. Useful everywhere, these are highly valued in <SPECIAL>trading<> economies where competition between workers is fierce.
TRA_EXOTICS5.name: Neural Duct
TRA_EXOTICS5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)

TRA_MINERALS1.description:
Several tonnes of dirt.

Leftover dirt from mining operations. Residual metals can be extracted by specialists in <SPECIAL>manufacturing<> economies with the time and equipment to sift through it.
TRA_MINERALS1.name: Dirt
TRA_MINERALS1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)

TRA_MINERALS2.description:
Large jars full of pyrite grease.

A fat solution with a high mineral content. This grease is highly valued by <SPECIAL>manufacturing<> economies, where it's used to keep large machinery oiled and glistening.
TRA_MINERALS2.name: Unrefined Pyrite Grease
TRA_MINERALS2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)

TRA_MINERALS3.description:
A crate of bromide salt.

The result of an extensive distillation and evaporation process, the bromide salt vats feed hungry factories in <SPECIAL>manufacturing<> systems.
TRA_MINERALS3.name: Bromide Salt
TRA_MINERALS3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)

TRA_MINERALS4.description:
A sack full of polychromatic zirconium crystals.

These crystals produce lenses of dazzling colour and near-indestructible hardness. Highly valuable in <SPECIAL>manufacturing<> economies.
TRA_MINERALS4.name: Polychromatic Zirconium
TRA_MINERALS4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)

TRA_MINERALS5.description:
A neatly wrapped parcel of re-latticed arc crystals.

Extremely rare mineral formations, arc crystals are in high demand in <SPECIAL>manufacturing<> economies, where their hardness and conductivity is vital to several industrial processes. They also make alluring (if dangerous) jewellery.
TRA_MINERALS5.name: Re-latticed Arc Crystal
TRA_MINERALS5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)

TRA_TECH1.description:
A collection of salvaged circuitry.

<SPECIAL>Power generation<> economies go through vast numbers of high-tech components. As such, the demand is present even for highly damaged circuits, to be scavenged for parts or just plugged wholesale into low-quality power cores.
TRA_TECH1.name: Decommissioned Circuits
TRA_TECH1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)

TRA_TECH2.description:
Several large bars of welding soap.

Used in <SPECIAL>power generation<> systems to heat-clean metal diodes before they're fused into batteries.
TRA_TECH2.name: Welding Soap
TRA_TECH2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)

TRA_TECH3.description:
A reinforced crate of ion capacitors.

These supercapacitors have an incredibly high energy density. In great demand in <SPECIAL>power generation<> economies.
TRA_TECH3.name: Ion Capacitor
TRA_TECH3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)

TRA_TECH4.description:
A container of positioning units and associated wiring.

These APS units can be used to turn virtually any technology into a self-navigating system. Highly valuable in <SPECIAL>power generation<> economies, where they're used to remove conductive organic hands from the manufacturing process.
TRA_TECH4.name: Autonomous Positioning Unit
TRA_TECH4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)

TRA_TECH5.description:
Several large quantum accelerator units.
 
 Capable of propelling matter at unmeasurable speeds, these units are particularly important in <SPECIAL>power generation<> economies, where they're used to compress the energy stored in high-grade batteries.
TRA_TECH5.name: Quantum Accelerator
TRA_TECH5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)

TRIDENT_KEY.description:
A strange forked key, glowing with an ultraviolet light.

Despite its primitive appearance, Exosuit scanning systems reveal traces of nanite foam upon its teeth.
TRIDENT_KEY.name: Trident Key
TRIDENT_KEY.subtitle: Aquatic Relic

TUT_STARMAP.description: A map of a nearby planet. The coordinates of a distress signal<> have been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1<>)<> to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data<> with a Space Station Cartographer.
TUT_STARMAP.name: Planetary Chart
TUT_STARMAP.subtitle: Cartographic Data

TWITCH_GUN01.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This rifle comes with the lethal Blaze Javelin<> and recoil-stabilising Combat Scope<> pre-installed. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
TWITCH_GUN01.name: Quantum Harmoniser Mark IV
TWITCH_GUN01.subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device

TWITCH_GUN02.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This pistol comes with the offensive Boltcaster<> and defensive Personal Forcefield<> pre-installed. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
TWITCH_GUN02.name: Loop Scoop Mark IV
TWITCH_GUN02.subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device

TWITCH_GUN03.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This specialised tool comes with an Advanced Mining Laser<> and powerful Optical Drill<> upgrade pre-installed. Take<> this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange<> it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU<>).
TWITCH_GUN03.name: Arc Capacitor W/17l-15P
TWITCH_GUN03.subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device

TWITCH_GUN04.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool<>. This specialised tool comes with several scanning<> upgrades pre-installed, to increase the efficiency and profitability of scanning planetary discoveries. ULTRAPROD1.description:
A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes.

ULTRAPROD1.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology

ULTRAPROD2.description:
A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous.

Crafted from <TECHNOLOGY>Quantum Processors<>, <TECHNOLOGY>Cryogenic Chambers<>, and <SPECIAL>Iridesite<>.
ULTRAPROD2.name: Stasis Device
ULTRAPROD2.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology

VENTGEM.description:
Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality.

Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.
VENTGEM.name: Crystal Sulphide
VENTGEM.subtitle: Compressed Mineral

WALKER_PROD.description:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch.

A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.
WALKER_PROD.name: Walker Brain
WALKER_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material

WALKER_PROD_2.description:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a <SPECIAL>pugneum filament<>, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

Unlike most Walker brains, this one has survived its violent extraction and is <TECHNOLOGY>pristine<> and <TECHNOLOGY>undamaged<>. It could potentially be installed in a new vessel...
WALKER_PROD_2.name: Pristine Brain
WALKER_PROD_2.subtitle: Anomalous Material

WALKER_PROD_3.description:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a <SPECIAL>pugneum filament<>, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.

Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by <STELLAR>Iteration: Tethys<>. Its new-found freedom from the Atlas has been <FUEL>noted<> by the universe.
WALKER_PROD_3.name: Hacked Brain
WALKER_PROD_3.subtitle: Anomalous Material

WALKER_PROD_4.description:
Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a <SPECIAL>pugneum filament<>, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile.

Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by both <STELLAR>Iteration: Tethys<> and a <FUEL>Messenger of the Atlas<>.
WALKER_PROD_4.name: Radiant Brain
WALKER_PROD_4.subtitle: Anomalous Material

WAR_CURIO1.description:
A small wooden icon carved into the shape of a Sentinel drone.
 
Used by warriors to enter a temporary trance-like state that eliminates their kind's need for sleep.
WAR_CURIO1.name: Vy'keen Effigy
WAR_CURIO1.subtitle: Medium value curiosity

WAR_CURIO2.description: Largely ceremonial weapon. A vital part of Vy'keen tradition and culture.
WAR_CURIO2.name: Vy'keen Dagger
WAR_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity

WAR_CURIO3.description:
A stone tablet bearing line after line of intricate runes. The words are unintelligible, an ancient dialect forgotten by all but the oldest of the Vy'keen elders.

The hand that carved this stone must have been extraordinary. The stonework is precise, delicate - and yet perfectly conveys the unyielding aggression its writer clearly possessed.
WAR_CURIO3.name: Vy'keen Tablet
WAR_CURIO3.subtitle: Communion of Hirk

WATER1.description:
A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in <TECHNOLOGY>underwater minerals<>.

Can be processed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create <TRADEABLE>Chlorine<>. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.
WATER1.name: Salt
WATER1.subtitle: Aquatic Mineral Extract

WATER2.description:
A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in <TECHNOLOGY>oceans<>.

Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
WATER2.name: Chlorine
WATER2.subtitle: Processed Aquatic Mineral

WATERPLANT.description:
A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies.
 
The <TECHNOLOGY>Mining Laser<> will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from <TECHNOLOGY>underwater flora<>.
WATERPLANT.name: Cyto-Phosphate
WATERPLANT.subtitle: Organic Compound

WATERPROD3.description:
A tightly-bonded form of Chlorine. Rigidly-packed molecules offer unrivalled conductivity. Not known to form spontaneously: creation requires highly-focused energy inputs.

Synthesised from <CATALYST>Chlorine<>.
WATERPROD3.name: Chloride Lattice
WATERPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Chlorine Deposit

WATERWORLD1.description:
Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an <TECHNOLOGY>Analysis Visor<>.

Typically found on <TECHNOLOGY>ocean planets<>.
WATERWORLD1.name: Lithium
WATERWORLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element

WATER_CRAFT.description:
A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems. 

This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.
WATER_CRAFT.name: Salt Refractor
WATER_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component

WEAP_INV_TOKEN.description:
A flexible upgrade circuit, compatible with all <STELLAR>person Multi-Tools<>.

This module can be wired into a Multi-Tool at a Space Station <STELLAR>Multi-Tool Upgrade Rack<>, granting the user more space in the Multi-Tool's internal layout to add further upgrades or technology specialisations.
WEAP_INV_TOKEN.name: Multi-Tool Expansion Slot
WEAP_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Upgrade Unit

WHALE_BEACON.description:
A signal receiver and amplifier, tuned to the wavelength of the unconscious mind. It is every colour all at once, splitting the surrounding light into a shimmering rainbow.

<FUEL>Warning:<> Carrying this antenna into deep space may attract the attention of <SPECIAL>cosmic megafauna<>.
WHALE_BEACON.name: Dream Aerial
WHALE_BEACON.subtitle: Subconscious Access Device

WORMBOOK.description:
A translucent sheet of <STELLAR>worm-vellum<>, inscribed with a fanatical text. It writhes when touched.

'The children were the first to notice.
A thump thump thump, thundering deep below the sand.
The first worm split the sky like black lightning as it leapt overhead. 
Worm by worm, they rose from the desert. Migrating.
Every storm season, we each hope to be chosen. We arrange ourselves in lines across the desert, arms lifted to the sky.
Anyone may enter the maw.
We are all equal under the great worms.'
WORMBOOK.name: Writhing Manuscript
WORMBOOK.subtitle: Cultist Document

WORMCORE.description:
The coiled remains of a <SPECIAL>Hungering Tendril<>'s digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps...

Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus <STELLAR>highly valuable<>.
WORMCORE.name: Flesh Rope
WORMCORE.subtitle: Intestinal Fragment

WORMDUST.description:
A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet.

Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by <SPECIAL>titan worm activity<>.
WORMDUST.name: Cursed Dust
WORMDUST.subtitle: Ashes of Despair

WORMPROD.description:
The fragile embryo of a <SPECIAL>Hungering Tendril<>, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched.

May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a <TECHNOLOGY>Visceral Synthesiser<>.
WORMPROD.name: Vile Spawn
WORMPROD.subtitle: Hungering Embryo

WORMSCROLL1.description:
Ancient words are carved into this <STELLAR>living document<>. They read:

'The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky.
Our pathetic shells cannot follow, cannot reach its height, cannot reach its depths.
We offer ourselves to the ground.
We beg our sacrifice accepted.'
WORMSCROLL1.name: Wormskin Folio: 1
WORMSCROLL1.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll

WORMSCROLL2.description:
Ancient words are carved into this <STELLAR>living document<>. They read:

'The dust was choking. 
Our eyes reddened and watered. 
But the truth was inescapable.
The veins of the Atlas had surfaced.'
WORMSCROLL2.name: Wormskin Folio: 2
WORMSCROLL2.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll

WORMSCROLL3.description:
Ancient words are carved into this <STELLAR>living document<>. They read:

'Now with every storm we beg to be chosen;
Arms to the sky, faces to the dirt, calling out with all we have!
When heavy raindrops hit the earth, the veins of Atlas answer.
The rapture of our consumption is beyond words.'
WORMSCROLL3.name: Wormskin Folio: 3
WORMSCROLL3.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll

WORMSCROLL4.description:
Ancient words are carved into this <STELLAR>living document<>. They read:

'We tumble as it swallows, but grip the slick walls as best we can - 
Oh! - to reach the gizzard still awake. 
Breathe it deeply! How our lungs gurgle!
The slime clogs our noses and stings our eyes, 
though in this warm darkness, we are already blind.'
WORMSCROLL4.name: Wormskin Folio: 4
WORMSCROLL4.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll

WORMSCROLL5.description:
Ancient words are carved into this <STELLAR>living document<>. They read:

'Curse the agony of regurgitation, 
Curse this this feeble flesh that still confines me!
My brethren were reborn, rising from the blessed dust as fresh tendrils. 
Glistening capillaries to the great veins, slithering away into the sand.
I will be patient. Until the next storm.'
WORMSCROLL5.name: Wormskin Folio: 5
WORMSCROLL5.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll

YELLOW2.description:
A <STELLAR>chromatic metal<>, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets.

Copper is found on planets orbiting <CATALYST>yellow stars<>, and can be placed in a <TECHNOLOGY>Refiner<> to create purified <STELLAR>Chromatic Metal<> for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.
YELLOW2.name: Copper
YELLOW2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow
